diff --git a/packages/core/src/effort-policy.ts b/packages/core/src/effort-policy.ts

+++ b/packages/core/src/effort-policy.ts

+export * as EffortPolicy from "./effort-policy"
+
+import { AgentEffort } from "@opencode-ai/schema/agent-effort"
+import type { ReviewLoopState } from "./review-loop"
+
+/** Validation gate derived from the effort level — the second of the two switches. */
+export type ValidationGate = "minimal" | "standard" | "full"
+
+export type ValidationCategory = "syntax" | "smoke" | "tests" | "typecheck" | "parity"
+
+export type ValidationStatus = "passed" | "failed" | "not-run" | "not-applicable"
+
+export type ValidationCheck = {
+  readonly category: ValidationCategory
+  readonly status: ValidationStatus
+  readonly detail: string
+}
+
+export type ValidationDeclaration = {
+  readonly checks: readonly ValidationCheck[]
+}
+
+export type ValidationReport = {
+  readonly gate: ValidationGate
+  readonly status: "passed" | "failed" | "incomplete"
+  readonly checks: readonly ValidationCheck[]
+  readonly source: "agent-reported"
+}
+
+/**
+ * Honest delivery status written to `metadata.review.termination`.
+ * Never an approval unless a valid independent review actually approved the
+ * delivered work.
+ */
+export type Termination =
+  | "unreviewed"
+  | "approved"
+  | "findings-open"
+  | "budget-exhausted"
+  | "review-unavailable"
+  | "review-blocked"
+  | "review-pending"
+  | "not-required"
+  | "waiting"
+
+export type Disposition = "reviewed" | "unreviewed"
+
+export type FinishReason = "success" | "failure" | "subagent_wait"
+
+export type FinishInput = {
+  readonly effort: AgentEffort.Level
+  readonly reason: FinishReason
+  readonly state: ReviewLoopState
+  /** Dispatch capability of the routed reviewer in this session's context. */
+  readonly reviewerAvailable: boolean
+  /** Why the reviewer is unavailable, when it is. */
+  readonly unavailableReason?: string
+  /** Typed reason code for an unavailable reviewer (for example `subagent-depth`), when known. */
+  readonly unavailableCode?: string
+  /**
+   * A depth-limited child with a parent cannot dispatch review: its writes are handed
+   * back to the parent as unreviewed (`review-pending`), never approved.
+   */
+  readonly handoff?: boolean
+}
+
+export type FinishOutcome = {
+  readonly deliver: boolean
+  readonly disposition: Disposition
+  readonly termination: Termination
+  /** Finite pass limit to serialize, when one applies to this level. */
+  readonly maxIterations?: number
+  /** Recoverable feedback for the model when the finish call is declined. */
+  readonly feedback?: string
+  readonly unavailableReason?: string
+}
+
+/**
+ * The first of the two switches: how many independent review passes a level
+ * requires. `0` means none are required; `undefined` means until-clean with no
+ * finite cap (thorough).
+ */
+export function passLimit(level: AgentEffort.Level): number | undefined {
+  if (level === "fast") return 0
+  if (level === "medium") return 2
+  return undefined
+}
+
+/** The second of the two switches: which validation evidence a level expects. */
+export function validationGate(level: AgentEffort.Level): ValidationGate {
+  if (level === "fast") return "minimal"
+  if (level === "medium") return "standard"
+  return "full"
+}
+
+const GATE_CATEGORIES: Record<ValidationGate, readonly ValidationCategory[]> = {
+  minimal: ["syntax", "smoke"],
+  standard: ["tests"],
+  full: ["tests", "typecheck", "parity"],
+}
+
+/**
+ * Categories a gate expects evidence for. A category the agent declares
+ * `not-applicable` is satisfied by that declaration; a category with no
+ * declared check at all leaves the report incomplete. Nothing here executes:
+ * the declaration is agent-reported evidence only, never verified commands.
+ */
+export function requiredCategories(gate: ValidationGate): readonly ValidationCategory[] {
+  return GATE_CATEGORIES[gate]
+}
+
+/** Derive the validation report from the effective level and the optional declaration. */
+export function deriveValidation(input: {
+  effort: AgentEffort.Level
+  declaration?: ValidationDeclaration
+}): ValidationReport {
+  const gate = validationGate(input.effort)
+  const checks = input.declaration?.checks ?? []
+  const status = ((): ValidationReport["status"] => {
+    if (checks.some((check) => check.status === "failed")) return "failed"
+    const statusByCategory = new Map(checks.map((check) => [check.category, check.status]))
+    // Minimal is satisfied by ONE actually-passed applicable check: syntax OR
+    // smoke. When neither can apply, both categories declared explicitly
+    // not-applicable satisfy it honestly; empty, all-not-run, or missing
+    // evidence stays incomplete. Nothing here executes: a declaration is
+    // agent-reported evidence only.
+    if (gate === "minimal") {
+      const applicable = requiredCategories(gate)
+      if (applicable.some((category) => statusByCategory.get(category) === "passed")) return "passed"
+      if (applicable.every((category) => statusByCategory.get(category) === "not-applicable")) return "passed"
+      return "incomplete"
+    }
+    const covered = new Set(checks.filter((check) => check.status !== "not-run").map((check) => check.category))
+    const missing = requiredCategories(gate).some((category) => !covered.has(category))
+    return missing ? "incomplete" : "passed"
+  })()
+  return { gate, status, checks, source: "agent-reported" }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Decide whether this `finish` call delivers, and with which honest labels.
+ *
+ * Enforcement lives here, at the finish checkpoint, and depends only on the persisted review
+ * state, never on how often finish was attempted.
+ *
+ * - `fast`: no mandatory review. Delivers with an honest unreviewed/findings label.
+ * - `medium`: at least one independent review, then at most two completed attempts. Blocking
+ *   findings or stale work force another pass until the cap; after the cap delivery is labelled
+ *   budget-exhausted, never approved.
+ * - `thorough`: until-clean with no pass cap.
+ *
+ * For medium and thorough (#233): an unavailable reviewer BLOCKS a successful finish. Only a
+ * declared failure may deliver with `review-blocked`, and a depth-limited child hands its writes
+ * to its parent as `review-pending`. A declared failure with a dispatchable reviewer is still
+ * reviewed. `subagent_wait` is a provisional yield, never approval. Read-only turns are exempt and
+ * labelled `not-required`, distinct from approval.
+ */
+export function evaluateFinish(input: FinishInput): FinishOutcome {
+  const { effort, reason, state, reviewerAvailable } = input
+  // A delivered verdict is what makes a review "happened"; an errored or malformed attempt only
+  // spends budget.
+  const reviewed = state.lastReviewVerdict !== undefined
+  const disposition: Disposition = reviewed ? "reviewed" : "unreviewed"
+  const limit = passLimit(effort)
+  const maxIterations = limit !== undefined && limit > 0 && Number.isFinite(limit) ? limit : undefined
+  const common: { disposition: Disposition; maxIterations?: number } = {
+    disposition,
+    ...(maxIterations !== undefined ? { maxIterations } : {}),
+  }
+
+  if (reason === "subagent_wait") return { deliver: true, termination: "waiting", ...common }
+
+  if (!state.workSeen) {
+    // No code changes this task: exempt from the review ritual, labelled distinctly from approval.
+    if (reason === "failure") return { deliver: true, termination: "unreviewed", ...common }
+    return { deliver: true, termination: "not-required", ...common }
+  }
+
+  const converged =
+    reviewed && !state.workSinceReview && state.lastReviewVerdict === "approved" && state.blockingFindings === 0
+  const blocking = state.blockingFindings > 0
+
+  const deliverableTermination = ((): Termination => {
+    if (state.workSinceReview) return reviewed ? "findings-open" : "unreviewed"
+    if (converged) return "approved"
+    if (state.lastReviewVerdict === "needs-fixes") return "findings-open"
+    if (reviewed) return "findings-open"
+    return "unreviewed"
+  })()
+
+  if (effort === "fast") {
+    // Fast requires no review. With no verdict on record the honest label is unreviewed.
+    return { deliver: true, termination: deliverableTermination, ...common }
+  }
+
+  if (state.reviewInProgress) {
+    return decline(common, "A synchronous review is already in progress. Wait for its report before finishing.")
+  }
+
+  const exhausted = limit !== undefined && state.reviews >= limit
+
+  // Blocked, handed off, or declared failure: never a silent approval.
+  const unavailable = (): FinishOutcome => {
+    const unavailableReason = input.unavailableReason ?? "no reviewer is dispatchable in this session's context"
+    if (input.handoff) return { deliver: true, termination: "review-pending", ...common, unavailableReason }
+    if (reason === "failure") return { deliver: true, termination: "review-blocked", ...common, unavailableReason }
+    return decline(
+      common,
+      `Review blocked (${input.unavailableCode ?? unavailableReason}): success cannot be reported without review. Restore Review dispatch or report failure honestly.`,
+      unavailableReason,
+    )
+  }
+
+  if (effort === "medium") {
+    if (exhausted && !converged) {
+      // At the cap: a blocking or unapproved last verdict is budget-exhausted; stale work after an
+      // approval is findings-open. Neither is ever labelled approved.
+      const approvedStale = reviewed && state.lastReviewVerdict === "approved" && !blocking
+      return { deliver: true, termination: approvedStale ? "findings-open" : "budget-exhausted", ...common }
+    }
+    if (!reviewed) return reviewerAvailable ? decline(common, reviewRequired(effort)) : unavailable()
+    if (blocking || state.workSinceReview || state.lastReviewVerdict !== "approved") {
+      if (!reviewerAvailable) return unavailable()
+      return decline(
+        common,
+        state.workSinceReview
+          ? "Review required: work changed after the last review, so the current tree has no explicit Approved review. Run the Review subagent again before finishing."
+          : `Review required: the latest report from the Review subagent returned Needs fixes, with ${state.blockingFindings} blocking finding(s) (critical/important) or no findings listed, so the current work is not approved. Fix the findings, then run the Review subagent again (\`subagent_type: "review"\`, \`background: false\`) before finishing.`,
+      )
+    }
+    return { deliver: true, termination: deliverableTermination, ...common }
+  }
+
+  // thorough: until-clean, no finite cap.
+  if (!reviewed || blocking || state.lastReviewVerdict !== "approved" || state.workSinceReview) {
+    if (!reviewerAvailable) return unavailable()
+    return decline(
+      common,
+      state.workSinceReview && state.lastReviewVerdict === "approved"
+        ? "Work changed after the approved review, so the current tree is no longer covered. Run another synchronous review before finishing."
+        : 'Review required: effort is "thorough", so delivery requires a clean, current independent review from the Review subagent (\`subagent_type: "review"\`, \`background: false\`). Address the outstanding findings and run it again before finishing.',
+    )
+  }
+  return { deliver: true, termination: "approved", ...common }
+}
+
+function reviewRequired(effort: AgentEffort.Level) {
+  return `Review required: this task changed files and effort is "${effort}", which requires at least one independent review before delivery. The current work has no explicit Approved review from the Review subagent. Run the Review subagent now: call the \`task\` tool with \`subagent_type: "review"\` and \`background: false\`, then call finish after it returns Approved.`
+}
+
+function decline(
+  common: { disposition: Disposition; maxIterations?: number },
+  feedback: string,
+  unavailableReason?: string,
+): FinishOutcome {
+  return {
+    deliver: false,
+    termination: "unreviewed",
+    ...common,
+    feedback,
+    ...(unavailableReason ? { unavailableReason } : {}),
+  }
+}

+/**

+ * completed; the marker also lives on non-tool parts (a background task
+ * notification carrying its child's delegated writes), where any occurrence
+ * counts. The declaration lives on the tool definition or is propagated by the
+ * task tool, so a new file-writing surface is classified where it is defined.

+  // Errored and still-running tools count: their writes may already be on disk.

+/** The pass budget the verdict's `cap` state is derived from. */
+function passBudget(options: number | ReviewLoopOptions | undefined) {
+  if (typeof options === "number" || options === undefined) {
+    const max = options ?? 5
+    return Number.isFinite(max) && max > 0 ? max : 1
+  }
+  if (options.effort === undefined) {
+    const max = options.maxIterations ?? 5
+    return Number.isFinite(max) && max > 0 ? max : 1
+  }
+  // fast performs no required passes and thorough is until-clean: neither has a
+  // finite cap. Medium is the bounded interactive level: two review passes.
+  return options.effort === "medium" ? 2 : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
+}

-export function migrate(info: typeof ConfigV1.Info.Type) {
+/**
+ * The `agent` key is ambiguous by design: v2 nests the reserved `effort`
+ * setting under it, while v1 uses it as a named-agent map. A map is legacy
+ * evidence unless its only meaningful entry is the scalar `effort` setting —
+ * a key named `effort` with a non-string value is a named agent, and any
+ * other key is a named agent that only the v1 shape carries.
+ */
+function isLegacyAgentMap(value: unknown) {
+  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false
+  return Object.entries(value).some(([key, entry]) => (key === "effort" ? typeof entry !== "string" : true))
+}

+/**
+ * `native` is the raw config document: the v1 decode cannot see v2-only
+ * `agents`/`providers` entries, so migration carries them across explicitly.
+ * Native entries win over same-named legacy definitions; legacy-only
+ * definitions survive unchanged.
+ */
+export function migrate(info: typeof ConfigV1.Info.Type, native?: unknown) {

+  const nativeProviders =
+    typeof raw.providers === "object" && raw.providers !== null ? (raw.providers as Record<string, unknown>) : undefined
   return {
     $schema: info.$schema,
     shell: info.shell,
     model: info.model,
     default_agent: info.default_agent,

+/** The reserved scalar `agent.effort` policy, if configured. A legacy object-valued `effort` entry is a named agent, not the setting. */
+function agentEffort(agent: typeof ConfigV1.Info.Type.agent) {
+  const value = agent?.effort
+  return typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined

+/** The reserved scalar migrates to the canonical nested v2 `agent` settings object. */
+function agentSettings(agent: typeof ConfigV1.Info.Type.agent) {

+/** Carry native v2 entries across migration with precedence over same-named legacy entries. */
+function withNative<T extends Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>(
+  legacy: T | undefined,
+  native: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+): T | undefined {
+  if (!native) return legacy
+  return { ...(legacy ?? {}), ...native } as T

+/** Baseline reviewed-work state: one unit of declared file-writing work, no reviews yet. */
+function workState(overrides: Partial<ReviewLoopState> = {}): ReviewLoopState {

+  return EffortPolicy.evaluateFinish({ effort, reason: "success", state, reviewerAvailable })

+function envelope(assessment: "approved" | "needs-fixes", findings: ReadonlyArray<Record<string, unknown>> = []) {
+  return [
+    "<alphacode-review>",
+    JSON.stringify({ version: 1, revision: "uncommitted", assessment, summary: "assessment", findings }),
+    "</alphacode-review>",
+  ].join("\n")

+function reviewTask(assessment: "approved" | "needs-fixes", findings: ReadonlyArray<Record<string, unknown>> = []) {
+  return {
+    info: { role: "assistant" },
+    parts: [
+      {
+        type: "tool",
+        tool: "task",
+        state: {
+          status: "completed",
+          input: { subagent_type: "review", background: false },
+          output: envelope(assessment, findings),
+        },
+      },
+    ],
+  } as unknown as ReviewHistoryMessage
+}

+function writeTask() {
+  return {

+            workSinceReview: true,
+            lastReviewVerdict: "approved",
+          }),
+        ).deliver,
+      ).toBe(false)
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("thorough blocks success when the reviewer is unavailable, never as approval", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const outcome = evaluate("thorough", workState(), false)
+      expect(outcome.deliver).toBe(false)
+      expect(outcome.disposition).toBe("unreviewed")
+      expect(outcome.maxIterations).toBeUndefined()
+      expect(outcome.feedback).toContain("Review blocked")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("thorough delivers an approved review with no finite cap", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const outcome = evaluate(
+        "thorough",
+        workState({
+          verdict: "approved",
+          reviews: 4,
+          workSinceReview: false,
+          phase: "review",
+          lastReviewVerdict: "approved",
+        }),
+      )
+      expect(outcome.deliver).toBe(true)
+      expect(outcome.termination).toBe("approved")
+      expect(outcome.maxIterations).toBeUndefined()
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("failure and subagent_wait deliver without an approval ritual", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const failed = EffortPolicy.evaluateFinish({
+        effort: "medium",
+        reason: "failure",
+        state: workState(),
+        reviewerAvailable: true,
+      })
+      // #233: a declared failure is still reviewed when a reviewer can run.
+      expect(failed.deliver).toBe(false)
+      expect(failed.feedback).toContain("requires at least one independent review")
+
+      const waiting = EffortPolicy.evaluateFinish({
+        effort: "medium",
+        reason: "subagent_wait",
+        state: workState(),
+        reviewerAvailable: true,
+      })
+      expect(waiting.deliver).toBe(true)
+      expect(waiting.termination).toBe("waiting")
+      expect(waiting.disposition).toBe("unreviewed")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("read-only turns are exempt but labelled distinctly from approval", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const quiet = workState({ workSeen: false, workSinceReview: false, verdict: "none", phase: "review" })
+      const success = evaluate("thorough", quiet)
+      expect(success.deliver).toBe(true)
+      expect(success.termination).toBe("not-required")
+
+      const failed = EffortPolicy.evaluateFinish({
+        effort: "thorough",
+        reason: "failure",
+        state: quiet,
+        reviewerAvailable: true,
+      })
+      expect(failed.deliver).toBe(true)
+      expect(failed.termination).toBe("unreviewed")
+    }),
+  )
+})
+
+describe("validation derivation", () => {
+  const check = (category: EffortPolicy.ValidationCategory, status: EffortPolicy.ValidationStatus) => ({
+    category,
+    status,
+    detail: `${category} ${status}`,
+  })
+
+  it.effect("minimal is satisfied by either applicable check", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const syntax = EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({
+        effort: "fast",
+        declaration: { checks: [check("syntax", "passed")] },
+      })
+      expect(syntax.status).toBe("passed")
+      const smoke = EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({
+        effort: "fast",
+        declaration: { checks: [check("smoke", "passed")] },
+      })
+      expect(smoke.status).toBe("passed")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("minimal accepts both categories declared explicitly not-applicable", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const report = EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({
+        effort: "fast",
+        declaration: { checks: [check("syntax", "not-applicable"), check("smoke", "not-applicable")] },
+      })
+      expect(report.status).toBe("passed")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("minimal stays incomplete without an actually-passed applicable check", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      expect(EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({ effort: "fast" }).status).toBe("incomplete")
+      expect(EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({ effort: "fast", declaration: { checks: [] } }).status).toBe("incomplete")
+      expect(
+        EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({ effort: "fast", declaration: { checks: [check("syntax", "not-run")] } }).status,
+      ).toBe("incomplete")
+      expect(
+        EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({
+          effort: "fast",
+          declaration: { checks: [check("syntax", "not-run"), check("tests", "passed")] },
+        }).status,
+      ).toBe("incomplete")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("a failed check fails the report regardless of gate or other passes", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const minimal = EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({
+        effort: "fast",
+        declaration: { checks: [check("syntax", "passed"), check("smoke", "failed")] },
+      })
+      expect(minimal.status).toBe("failed")
+      const full = EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({
+        effort: "thorough",
+        declaration: {
+          checks: [check("tests", "passed"), check("typecheck", "passed"), check("parity", "failed")],
+        },
+      })
+      expect(full.status).toBe("failed")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("standard requires tests evidence only", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      expect(
+        EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({ effort: "medium", declaration: { checks: [check("tests", "passed")] } }).status,
+      ).toBe("passed")
+      expect(
+        EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({ effort: "medium", declaration: { checks: [check("smoke", "passed")] } }).status,
+      ).toBe("incomplete")
+      expect(
+        EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({ effort: "medium", declaration: { checks: [check("tests", "not-run")] } })
+          .status,
+      ).toBe("incomplete")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("full requires tests, typecheck and parity evidence", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const complete = EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({
+        effort: "thorough",
+        declaration: {
+          checks: [check("tests", "passed"), check("typecheck", "passed"), check("parity", "passed")],
+        },
+      })
+      expect(complete.status).toBe("passed")
+      const missingParity = EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({
+        effort: "thorough",
+        declaration: { checks: [check("tests", "passed"), check("typecheck", "passed")] },
+      })
+      expect(missingParity.status).toBe("incomplete")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("the report is declared agent-reported evidence, echoed verbatim", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const report = EffortPolicy.deriveValidation({
+        effort: "medium",
+        declaration: { checks: [check("tests", "passed")] },
+      })
+      expect(report.gate).toBe("standard")
+      expect(report.source).toBe("agent-reported")
+      expect(report.checks).toEqual([check("tests", "passed")])
+    }),
+  )
+})
+
+describe("review severity and lifecycle (persisted-history evaluator)", () => {
+  it.effect("critical and important findings block; minor findings do not; empty needs-fixes floors at one", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const blocking = reviewLoopState(
+        [
+          userTurn(),
+          writeTask(),
+          reviewTask("needs-fixes", [
+            { severity: "critical", title: "broken" },
+            { severity: "important", title: "risky" },
+            { severity: "minor", title: "style" },
+          ]),
+        ],
+        { effort: "medium" },
+      )
+      expect(blocking.blockingFindings).toBe(2)
+      expect(blocking.openFindings).toBe(3)
+
+      const minorOnly = reviewLoopState(
+        [userTurn(), writeTask(), reviewTask("approved", [{ severity: "minor", title: "style" }])],
+        { effort: "medium" },
+      )
+      expect(minorOnly.blockingFindings).toBe(0)
+      expect(minorOnly.verdict).toBe("approved")
+
+      const empty = reviewLoopState([userTurn(), writeTask(), reviewTask("needs-fixes")], { effort: "medium" })
+      expect(empty.blockingFindings).toBe(1)
+      expect(empty.verdict).toBe("needs-fixes")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("a new user task resets the previous task's review budget", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const state = reviewLoopState(
+        [userTurn("first"), writeTask(), reviewTask("approved"), userTurn("second"), writeTask()],
+        { effort: "medium" },
+      )
+      expect(state.reviews).toBe(0)
+      expect(state.verdict).toBe("pending")
+      expect(state.workSeen).toBe(true)
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("a background review and a failed review delivery never count as a pass", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const background = reviewLoopState(
+        [
+          userTurn(),
+          writeTask(),
+          {
+            info: { role: "assistant" },
+            parts: [
+              {
+                type: "tool",
+                tool: "task",
+                state: {
+                  status: "completed",
+                  input: { subagent_type: "review", background: true },
+                  output: envelope("approved"),
+                },
+              },
+            ],
+          } as unknown as ReviewHistoryMessage,
+        ],
+        { effort: "medium" },
+      )
+      expect(background.reviews).toBe(0)
+
+      const malformed = reviewLoopState(
+        [
+          userTurn(),
+          writeTask(),
+          {
+            info: { role: "assistant" },
+            parts: [
+              {
+                type: "tool",
+                tool: "task",
+                state: {
+                  status: "completed",
+                  input: { subagent_type: "review", background: false },
+                  output: "Assessment: Approved, I think? [Approved | Needs fixes]",
+                },
+              },
+            ],
+          } as unknown as ReviewHistoryMessage,
+        ],
+        { effort: "medium" },
+      )
+      expect(malformed.reviews).toBe(1)
+      expect(malformed.lastReviewVerdict).toBeUndefined()
+      expect(malformed.verdict).not.toBe("approved")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("legacy transcripts stay readable on the numeric cap", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const approved = reviewLoopState(
+        [userTurn(), writeTask(), ...Array.from({ length: 5 }, () => reviewTask("approved"))],
+        5,
+      )
+      expect(approved.reviews).toBe(5)
+      expect(approved.maxIterations).toBe(5)
+      expect(approved.verdict).toBe("approved")
+
+      // At the legacy cap with no clean approval, the verdict is the cap —
+      // never silently upgraded to approved.
+      const capped = reviewLoopState(
+        [
+          userTurn(),
+          writeTask(),
+          ...Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => reviewTask("approved")),
+          reviewTask("needs-fixes", [{ severity: "critical", title: "broken" }]),
+        ],
+        5,
+      )
+      expect(capped.reviews).toBe(5)
+      expect(capped.verdict).toBe("cap")
+      expect(capped.blockingFindings).toBe(1)
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("thorough is until-clean in the evaluator: no finite cap, no legacy override", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const state = reviewLoopState(
+        [userTurn(), writeTask(), ...Array.from({ length: 5 }, () => reviewTask("approved"))],
+        { effort: "thorough" },
+      )
+      expect(state.maxIterations).toBe(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
+      expect(state.verdict).toBe("approved")
+    }),
+  )
+})
+
+describe("config detection and migration", () => {
+  it.effect("detects the nested policy-only agent setting as v2, not as a legacy map", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      expect(ConfigMigrateV1.isV1({ agent: { effort: "fast" } })).toBe(false)
+      expect(ConfigMigrateV1.isV1({ agent: { effort: "fast" }, agents: {}, default_agent: "writer" })).toBe(false)
+      expect(ConfigMigrateV1.isV1({ agent: { effort: "fast" }, providers: {} })).toBe(false)
+      expect(ConfigMigrateV1.isV1({ agent: {} })).toBe(false)
+      expect(ConfigMigrateV1.isV1({ agent: { writer: { description: "named" } } })).toBe(true)
+      // A key named `effort` with an object value is a named agent, not the setting.
+      expect(ConfigMigrateV1.isV1({ agent: { effort: { description: "named effort agent" } } })).toBe(true)
+      expect(ConfigMigrateV1.isV1({ agent: { effort: "fast", writer: { description: "named" } } })).toBe(true)
+      expect(ConfigMigrateV1.isV1({ mode: { writer: { prompt: "p" } } })).toBe(true)
+      expect(ConfigMigrateV1.isV1({ default_agent: "writer" })).toBe(false)
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("migrates the v1 scalar effort into the canonical nested agent setting", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const migrated = ConfigMigrateV1.migrate({ agent: { effort: "thorough" } })
+      expect(migrated.agent).toEqual({ effort: "thorough" })
+      expect("effort" in migrated).toBe(false)
+      // The scalar setting never becomes a fake named agent.
+      expect(migrated.agents).toEqual({})
+      Schema.decodeUnknownSync(Config.Info)(migrated, { errors: "all" })
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("a legacy object-valued effort entry migrates as a named agent, not the setting", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const migrated = ConfigMigrateV1.migrate({ agent: { effort: { description: "named effort agent" } } })
+      expect(migrated.agent).toBeUndefined()
+      expect(migrated.agents?.effort).toBeDefined()
+      Schema.decodeUnknownSync(Config.Info)(migrated, { errors: "all" })
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("native v2 agents and providers survive migration with native-over-legacy precedence", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const migrated = ConfigMigrateV1.migrate(
+        {
+          snapshot: false,
+          agent: { effort: "fast", legacy: { description: "legacy definition" } },
+          mode: { migrator: { description: "from mode" }, writer: { description: "from mode writer" } },
+        },
+        {
+          agents: { writer: { description: "native writer" }, scribe: { description: "native only" } },
+          providers: { custom: provider },
+        },
+      )
+      expect(migrated.agent).toEqual({ effort: "fast" })
+      expect(entry(migrated.agents?.writer).description).toBe("native writer")
+      expect(entry(migrated.agents?.scribe).description).toBe("native only")
+      expect(entry(migrated.agents?.legacy).description).toBe("legacy definition")
+      expect(entry(migrated.agents?.migrator).description).toBe("from mode")
+      expect(migrated.providers?.custom).toBeDefined()
+      Schema.decodeUnknownSync(Config.Info)(migrated, { errors: "all" })
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("the v2 schema admits all three levels at the nested location and rejects invalid ones", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const decode = Schema.decodeUnknownOption(Config.Info, { errors: "all", onExcessProperty: "ignore" })
+      for (const level of AgentEffort.levels) expect(Option.isSome(decode({ agent: { effort: level } }))).toBe(true)
+      expect(Option.isSome(decode({ agent: { effort: "bogus" } }))).toBe(false)
+      // A stale top-level `effort` is no longer a v2 field: it is ignored, not honoured.
+      const thorough = decode({ effort: "thorough", agent: { effort: "thorough" } })
+      expect(Option.isSome(thorough) && thorough.value.agent?.effort).toBe("thorough")
+    }),
+  )
+})
+
+/** Narrow an unknown migrated map entry for honest field assertions. */
+function entry(value: unknown) {
+  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null ? (value as Record<string, unknown>) : {}
+}

+describe("config load probes", () => {
+  it.live("loads the literal agent.effort alongside native v2 agents", () =>
+    Effect.acquireRelease(
+      Effect.promise(() => tmpdir()),
+      (tmp) => Effect.promise(() => tmp[Symbol.asyncDispose]()),
+    ).pipe(
+      Effect.flatMap((tmp) =>
+        Effect.gen(function* () {
+          yield* Effect.promise(() =>
+            fs.writeFile(
+              path.join(tmp.path, "opencode.json"),
+              JSON.stringify({
+                agent: { effort: "fast" },
+                agents: { writer: { description: "native writer", mode: "primary" } },
+                default_agent: "writer",
+              }),
+            ),
+          )
+
+          return yield* Effect.gen(function* () {
+            const config = yield* Config.Service
+            const documents = (yield* config.entries()).filter((entry) => entry.type === "document")
+
+            expect(documents).toHaveLength(1)
+            const info = documents[0]?.info
+            expect(info?.agent?.effort).toBe("fast")
+            expect(info?.agents?.writer?.description).toBe("native writer")
+            expect(info?.default_agent).toBe("writer")
+          }).pipe(Effect.provide(testLayer(tmp.path)))
+        }),
+      ),
+    ),
+  )
+
+  it.live("loads every valid effort scalar at the nested location", () =>
+    Effect.acquireRelease(
+      Effect.promise(() => tmpdir()),
+      (tmp) => Effect.promise(() => tmp[Symbol.asyncDispose]()),
+    ).pipe(
+      Effect.flatMap((tmp) =>
+        Effect.gen(function* () {
+          // A fresh layer per level re-reads the file, one document per load.
+          for (const level of AgentEffort.levels) {
+            yield* Effect.promise(() =>
+              fs.writeFile(path.join(tmp.path, "opencode.json"), JSON.stringify({ agent: { effort: level } })),
+            )
+            const documents = yield* Effect.gen(function* () {
+              const config = yield* Config.Service
+              return (yield* config.entries()).filter((entry) => entry.type === "document")
+            }).pipe(Effect.provide(testLayer(tmp.path)))
+            expect(documents).toHaveLength(1)
+            expect(documents[0]?.info.agent?.effort).toBe(level)
+          }
+        }),
+      ),
+    ),
+  )
+
+  it.live("rejects an invalid effort scalar without loading the document", () =>
+    Effect.acquireRelease(
+      Effect.promise(() => tmpdir()),
+      (tmp) => Effect.promise(() => tmp[Symbol.asyncDispose]()),
+    ).pipe(
+      Effect.flatMap((tmp) =>
+        Effect.gen(function* () {
+          yield* Effect.promise(() =>
+            fs.writeFile(path.join(tmp.path, "opencode.json"), JSON.stringify({ agent: { effort: "bogus" } })),
+          )
+

+            const config = yield* Config.Service
+            const documents = (yield* config.entries()).filter((entry) => entry.type === "document")
+            expect(documents).toHaveLength(0)
+          }).pipe(Effect.provide(testLayer(tmp.path)))
+        }),
+      ),
+    ),
+  )
+
+  it.live("migrates a mixed legacy document without dropping native agents or providers", () =>

+    ).pipe(
+      Effect.flatMap((tmp) =>
+        Effect.gen(function* () {
+          yield* Effect.promise(() =>
+            fs.writeFile(
+              path.join(tmp.path, "opencode.json"),

+                snapshot: false,
+                agent: { effort: "medium", legacy: { description: "legacy definition" } },
+                mode: { migrator: { description: "from mode" } },
+                agents: { writer: { description: "native writer" } },
+                providers: { custom: provider },
+              }),
+            ),
+          )
+

+            const info = documents[0]?.info
+            expect(info?.agent?.effort).toBe("medium")

+            expect(info?.agents?.legacy?.description).toBe("legacy definition")
+            expect(info?.agents?.migrator?.description).toBe("from mode")
+            expect(info?.providers?.custom).toBeDefined()
+            expect(info?.snapshots).toBe(false)
+          }).pipe(Effect.provide(testLayer(tmp.path)))
+        }),
+      ),
+    ),
+  )
+
+  it.live("preserves a legacy object-named effort agent through load", () =>
+    Effect.acquireRelease(
+      Effect.promise(() => tmpdir()),
+      (tmp) => Effect.promise(() => tmp[Symbol.asyncDispose]()),
+    ).pipe(
+      Effect.flatMap((tmp) =>
+        Effect.gen(function* () {
+          yield* Effect.promise(() =>
+            fs.writeFile(
+              path.join(tmp.path, "opencode.json"),
+              JSON.stringify({ snapshot: false, agent: { effort: { description: "named effort agent" } } }),
+            ),
+          )
+

+            const config = yield* Config.Service

+

+            const info = documents[0]?.info

+        }),
+      ),
+    ),
+  )

+    Effect.acquireRelease(
+      Effect.promise(() => tmpdir()),
+      (tmp) => Effect.promise(() => tmp[Symbol.asyncDispose]()),
+    ).pipe(
+      Effect.flatMap((tmp) =>
+        Effect.gen(function* () {
+          yield* Effect.promise(() =>
+            fs.writeFile(
+              path.join(tmp.path, "opencode.json"),
+              JSON.stringify({ snapshot: false, agent: { effort: "bogus" } }),
+            ),
+          )
+
+          return yield* Effect.gen(function* () {
+            const config = yield* Config.Service
+            const documents = (yield* config.entries()).filter((entry) => entry.type === "document")
+            expect(documents).toHaveLength(0)
+          }).pipe(Effect.provide(testLayer(tmp.path)))
+        }),
+      ),

+describe("effort policy – an approval never survives later work and an errored attempt", () => {
+  const erroredReviewTask = () =>
+    ({
+      info: { role: "assistant" },
+      parts: [
+        {
+          type: "tool",
+          tool: "task",
+          state: {
+            status: "error",
+            input: { subagent_type: "review", background: false },
+            error: "the review dispatch failed",
+          },
+        },
+      ],
+    }) as unknown as ReviewHistoryMessage
+
+  // Approved, then more file writes, then a review attempt that errored.
+  const staleThenErrored = (effort: AgentEffort.Level) =>
+    reviewLoopState([userTurn(), writeTask(), reviewTask("approved"), writeTask(), erroredReviewTask()], { effort })
+
+  it.effect("medium reaches its cap as budget-exhausted, never approved", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const state = staleThenErrored("medium")
+      expect(state.lastReviewVerdict).toBeUndefined()
+      const outcome = evaluate("medium", state)
+      expect(outcome.deliver).toBe(true)
+      expect(outcome.termination).toBe("budget-exhausted")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("thorough declines again rather than delivering an approval", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const state = staleThenErrored("thorough")
+      const outcome = evaluate("thorough", state)
+      expect(outcome.deliver).toBe(false)
+      expect(outcome.termination).not.toBe("approved")
+    }),
+  )
+
+  it.effect("fast labels the delivery unreviewed, never approved", () =>
+    Effect.sync(() => {
+      const outcome = evaluate("fast", staleThenErrored("fast"))
+      expect(outcome.deliver).toBe(true)
+      expect(outcome.termination).toBe("unreviewed")
+    }),
+  )
+})

+/**
+ * ask()'s per-pattern decision over the SAME ruleset ordering: the caller's
+ * ruleset first, the instance-approved always-allow grants last, so a granted
+ * always can mask a ruleset deny exactly as ask() decides it. Pure and
+ * readonly: it never prompts and never mutates approvals. ask() and
+ * denies() both consume this so their verdicts cannot drift apart.
+ */
+function assess(
+  permission: string,
+  patterns: readonly string[],
+  ruleset: PermissionV1.Ruleset,
+  approved: PermissionV1.Ruleset,
+): PermissionV1.Rule[] {
+  return patterns.map((pattern) => evaluate(permission, pattern, ruleset, approved))
+}

 ### Review and fix cycle
 
 1. Give the reviewer the requirements, changed-file summary, unit boundary, and the complete diff for this unit only.
 2. Read the final assessment. `Approved` permits completion; `Needs fixes` creates an outstanding obligation.
 3. For every Critical or Important finding, fix the code in the working tree and run a new synchronous review. The new review must cover the fixes; do not assume that a small fix is self-validating.

+5. Prefer not to call `finish` until a later review explicitly approves the current work. Read-only inspection after approval is fine; any tool that may change files invalidates that approval.

+The effort policy owns the pass budget: `fast` requires none, `medium` allows at most two completed review passes, and `thorough` is until-clean with no finite cap. The legacy configured `review_loop.max_iterations` value is not read by the effort policy: medium's budget is always two passes. +/** Session metadata key holding the persisted agent-effort selection. */
+export const AGENT_EFFORT_KEY = "agentEffort"
+
+/**
+ * Read the persisted effort through a schema decoder, so invalid legacy
+ * metadata resolves to `undefined` instead of poisoning effort resolution.
+ */
+export function readAgentEffort(metadata: typeof Metadata.Type | undefined) {
+  if (!metadata) return undefined
+  return Option.getOrUndefined(Schema.decodeUnknownOption(AgentEffort.Level)(metadata[AGENT_EFFORT_KEY]))

+  metadata: typeof Metadata.Type | undefined,
+  effort: AgentEffort.Level,
+): typeof Metadata.Type {
+  return { ...metadata, [AGENT_EFFORT_KEY]: effort }

 Pass `result` as a concise summary of what you did or answered. These are silent protocol signals, not something to announce to the user — do not say that you are finishing; just call it as the last step of your reply.
 
-If the current turn changed files, finish requires an explicit Approved review of that work from the Review subagent: dispatch it with the `task` tool, `subagent_type: "review"` and `background: false`, then call finish once it returns Approved. If it returns Needs fixes, fix the findings and run the Review subagent again. Until then every finish call is declined, whatever its `reason` other than `waiting_for_subagent` — a failed attempt still leaves its changes behind, so have them reviewed before reporting the failure. Retrying finish does not skip review, and calling the work creative, a prototype, trivial, or not production code in `result` does not exempt it. The runtime can stop at the configured review-attempt cap with `review-cap`, including errored synchronous review attempts. This is not approval. A writing child at the depth limit hands its files back with `review-pending`, explicitly UNREVIEWED: the parent must review those changes before reporting success. A missing, disabled, denied or hidden reviewer blocks success; report failure honestly with `review-blocked` instead. A per-message hidden task tool is not an exemption. None of these outcomes means the work was approved.
+Retrying finish does not skip review. When the medium pass budget is exhausted, the result is delivered as `budget-exhausted`, never as an approval. Medium and thorough dispatches that cannot run end as `review-blocked`, and a child's unreviewed handoff ends as `review-pending`. At medium and thorough effort, finish requires an explicit Approved review of that work from the Review subagent (dispatch it with `subagent_type: "review"` and `background: false`); at fast effort no review is required. Whether an independent review is required depends on your effort policy (fast/medium/thorough), and `finish` is the only enforcement checkpoint: when the effective level requires an independent review that has not happened, the call is declined with recoverable feedback. Repeated `finish` calls never waive a required review — the decision is based only on the persisted review state for this turn. At `fast`, no review is required and the result is honestly labelled unreviewed unless an independent review actually happened. At `medium`, deliver after at least one clean synchronous `review` pass (`subagent_type: "review"`, `background: false`); only blocking findings or work landed after the last review force another pass, bounded by two passes, after which `finish` delivers with an honest exhausted status. At `thorough`, `finish` keeps declining until a clean current review exists, or is blocked as `review-blocked` when the reviewer genuinely cannot run — never as approval.
+
+You may pass `validation.checks` declaring validation evidence for this result: one entry per check with `category` (syntax, smoke, tests, typecheck, parity), `status` (passed, failed, not-run, not-applicable), and a short `detail`. finish runs nothing itself — it records your declaration against the gate derived from your effort level, and missing or failed evidence is reported as incomplete/failed, never as passed.
 
 Call it once, after any other tool calls have completed. Do not call it to report partial progress, and do not use it to ask a question — use the question tool for questions and keep working otherwise.

 7. Clearly tell the agent whether you expect it to write code or just to do research (search, file reads, web fetches, etc.), since it is not aware of the user's intent. Tell it how to verify its work if possible (e.g., relevant test commands).
 8. Avoid delegating work that modifies the same files or areas you are also working on; concurrent edits to the same files can conflict.
 9. If the agent description mentions that it should be used proactively, then you should try your best to use it without the user having to ask for it first. Use your judgement.
+10. The optional `effort` parameter selects the child's agent-effort policy (fast, medium, or thorough). Omit it to reuse this child's persisted selection on resume, otherwise inherit your own/root selection, then the configured `agent.effort`, then medium. The resolved level persists on the child session before it runs and governs the child's review and validation requirements at its `finish` checkpoint; it never changes routing, permissions, or progress behavior.

+function named<T extends object>(value: T | string | undefined): T | undefined {
+  return typeof value === "string" ? undefined : value

+import { afterEach, describe, expect } from "bun:test"
+import { Database } from "@opencode-ai/core/database/database"
+import { LayerNode } from "@opencode-ai/core/effect/layer-node"
+import { SessionProjector } from "@opencode-ai/core/session/projector"
+import { Cause, Effect, Exit, Fiber } from "effect"

+import { PermissionV1 } from "@opencode-ai/core/v1/permission"

+// Narrows an optional persisted field by type. A missing field fails the test loudly.
+function present<T>(value: T | undefined): T {
+  if (value === undefined) throw new Error("expected the persisted field to be present")
+  return value
+}
+
+afterEach(async () => {
+  await disposeAllInstances()
+})
+
+const layer = () =>
+  LayerNode.compile(
+    LayerNode.group([
+      Database.node,
+      Session.node,
+      SessionProjector.node,
+      Todo.node,
+      Truncate.node,
+      Agent.node,
+      Config.node,
+      EventV2Bridge.node,
+      Permission.node,
+      CrossSpawnSpawner.node,
+      BackgroundJob.node,
+      SessionRunState.node,
+      SessionStatus.node,
+      ToolRegistry.node,
+      RuntimeFlags.node,
+      Ripgrep.node,

+  )

+const it = testEffect(layer())
