+const seedSession = Effect.fn("AgentEffortTest.seedSession")(function* (
+  options: {
+    title?: string
+    agent?: string
+    pinnedAgent?: string
+    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
+    permission?: PermissionV1.Rule[]
+  } = {},
+) {
+  const session = yield* Session.Service
+  const agent = options.agent ?? "work"
+  const chat = yield* session.create({
+    title: options.title ?? "test",
+    ...(options.pinnedAgent !== undefined ? { agent: options.pinnedAgent } : {}),
+    ...(options.metadata ? { metadata: options.metadata } : {}),
+    ...(options.permission ? { permission: options.permission } : {}),
+  })
+  const user = yield* session.updateMessage({
+    id: MessageID.ascending(),
+    role: "user",
+    sessionID: chat.id,
+    agent,
+    model: { providerID: "test" as never, modelID: "test-model" as never },
+    time: { created: Date.now() },
+  })
+  const assistant: SessionV1.Assistant = {
+    id: MessageID.ascending(),
+    role: "assistant",
+    parentID: user.id,
+    sessionID: chat.id,
+    mode: "work",
+    agent,
+    cost: 0,
+    path: { cwd: "/tmp", root: "/tmp" },
+    tokens: { input: 0, output: 0, reasoning: 0, cache: { read: 0, write: 0 } },
+    modelID: "test-model" as never,
+    providerID: "test" as never,
+    time: { created: Date.now() },
+  }
+  yield* session.updateMessage(assistant)
+  return { chat, assistant }
+})
+
+const addToolPart = Effect.fn("AgentEffortTest.addToolPart")(function* (
+  sessionID: SessionID,
+  messageID: MessageID,
+  tool: string,
+  input: Record<string, unknown> = {},
+  output = "done",
+  metadata: Record<string, unknown> = {},
+) {
+  const session = yield* Session.Service
+  const now = Date.now()
+  yield* session.updatePart({
+    id: PartID.ascending(),
+    messageID,
+    sessionID,
+    type: "tool",
+    tool,
+    callID: `${tool}-call-${PartID.ascending()}`,
+    state: {
+      status: "completed",
+      input,
+      output,
+      title: tool,
+      // Mirror Tool.define, which stamps file-writing tools with review metadata.
+      metadata: tool === "edit" ? { [REVIEW_LOOP_METADATA]: { writesFiles: true }, ...metadata } : { ...metadata },
+      time: { start: now, end: now },
+    },
+  })
+})
+
+// Long-turn fixture: every loop iteration appends a fresh assistant row
+// (prompt.ts), so assistant rows after the newest user message are how a real
+// session grows past task's newest-50 routing window.
+const fillAssistantRows = Effect.fn("AgentEffortTest.fillAssistantRows")(function* (
+  sessionID: SessionID,
+  parentID: MessageID,
+  count: number,
+) {
+  const session = yield* Session.Service
+  yield* Effect.forEach(
+    Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => index),
+    () =>
+      session.updateMessage({
+        id: MessageID.ascending(),
+        role: "assistant",
+        parentID,
+        sessionID,
+        mode: "work",
+        agent: "work",
+        cost: 0,
+        path: { cwd: "/tmp", root: "/tmp" },
+        tokens: { input: 0, output: 0, reasoning: 0, cache: { read: 0, write: 0 } },
+        modelID: "test-model" as never,
+        providerID: "test" as never,
+        time: { created: Date.now() },
+      }),
+  )
+})
+
+// The medium/thorough block: a successful finish whose reviewer cannot run
+// fails the tool call with the typed `Review blocked (<code>)` message.
+const blockedMessage = (exit: Exit.Exit<unknown, unknown>) => {
+  expect(Exit.isFailure(exit)).toBe(true)
+  if (!Exit.isFailure(exit)) return ""
+  const failure = Cause.squash(exit.cause)
+  expect(failure).toBeInstanceOf(ToolFailure)
+  return failure instanceof ToolFailure ? failure.message : ""
+}
+
+const finishContext = (sessionID: SessionID, messageID: MessageID) => ({
+  sessionID,
+  messageID,
+  agent: "work",
+  abort: new AbortController().signal,
+  messages: [],
+  metadata: () => Effect.void,
+  ask: () => Effect.void,
+})
+
+function stubOps(): TaskPromptOps {
+  return {
+    cancel: () => Effect.void,
+    resolvePromptParts: (template) => Effect.succeed([{ type: "text" as const, text: template }]),
+    prompt: (input: SessionPrompt.PromptInput) => Effect.succeed(reply(input)),
+  }
+}
+
+function reply(input: SessionPrompt.PromptInput): SessionV1.WithParts {
+  const id = MessageID.ascending()
+  return {
+    info: {
+      id,
+      role: "assistant",
+      parentID: input.messageID ?? MessageID.ascending(),
+      sessionID: input.sessionID,
+      mode: input.agent ?? "general",
+      agent: input.agent ?? "general",
+      cost: 0,
+      path: { cwd: "/tmp", root: "/tmp" },
+      tokens: { input: 0, output: 0, reasoning: 0, cache: { read: 0, write: 0 } },
+      modelID: input.model?.modelID ?? ("test-model" as never),
+      providerID: input.model?.providerID ?? ("test" as never),
+      time: { created: Date.now() },
+      finish: "stop",
+    },
+    parts: [
+      {
+        id: PartID.ascending(),
+        messageID: id,
+        sessionID: input.sessionID,
+        type: "text" as const,
+        text: "done",
+      },
+    ],
+  }
+}
+
+describe("tool.finish – effort-labelled delivery", () => {
+  it.instance(
+    "fast delivers unreviewed work as unreviewed with no serialized pass cap",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const result = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+
+        expect(result.title).toBe("Task completed")
+        const review = present(result.metadata.review)
+        expect(review.effort).toBe("fast")
+        expect(review.disposition).toBe("unreviewed")
+        expect(review.termination).toBe("unreviewed")
+        expect(review.reviews).toBe(0)
+        expect("maxIterations" in review).toBe(false)
+        expect(result.output).toContain("passes 0 (none required)")
+        expect(result.output).toContain("review unreviewed/unreviewed")
+        expect(result.output).not.toContain("budget")
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { effort: "fast" } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "fast labels an actual approved review as reviewed and approved",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        yield* addToolPart(
+          chat.id,
+          assistant.id,
+          "task",
+          { subagent_type: "review", background: false },
+          [
+            "<alphacode-review>",
+            JSON.stringify({
+              version: 1,
+              revision: "uncommitted",
+              assessment: "approved",
+              summary: "clean",
+              findings: [],
+            }),
+            "</alphacode-review>",
+          ].join("\n"),
+        )
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const result = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+
+        const review = present(result.metadata.review)
+        expect(review.effort).toBe("fast")
+        expect(review.disposition).toBe("reviewed")
+        expect(review.termination).toBe("approved")
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { effort: "fast" } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "failure and subagent_wait deliver without an approval ritual; read-only turns are not-required",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        const failed = yield* def.execute(
+          { reason: "failure", result: "gave up" },
+          finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+        expect(present(failed.metadata.review).termination).toBe("unreviewed")
+
+        const waiting = yield* def.execute(
+          { reason: "subagent_wait", result: "waiting on child" },
+          finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+        expect(present(waiting.metadata.review).termination).toBe("waiting")
+        expect(present(waiting.metadata.review).disposition).toBe("unreviewed")
+
+        const quiet = yield* seedSession({ title: "quiet" })
+        const exempt = yield* def.execute(
+          { reason: "success", result: "read the docs" },
+          finishContext(quiet.chat.id, quiet.assistant.id),
+        )
+        expect(present(exempt.metadata.review).termination).toBe("not-required")
+        expect(present(exempt.metadata.review).disposition).toBe("unreviewed")
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { effort: "fast" } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "declared validation evidence is reported as agent-reported, never executed",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const result = yield* def.execute(
+          {
+            reason: "success",
+            result: "done",
+            validation: { checks: [{ category: "syntax", status: "passed", detail: "biome check" }] },
+          },
+          finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+
+        expect(present(result.metadata.validation)).toEqual({
+          gate: "minimal",
+          status: "passed",
+          checks: [{ category: "syntax", status: "passed", detail: "biome check" }],
+          source: "agent-reported",
+        })
+        expect(result.output).toContain("validation minimal/passed")
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { effort: "fast" } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "missing validation evidence stays visible as incomplete even on a clean delivery",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const result = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+
+        expect(present(result.metadata.validation).gate).toBe("minimal")
+        expect(present(result.metadata.validation).status).toBe("incomplete")
+        expect(result.output).toContain("validation minimal/incomplete")
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { effort: "fast" } } },
+  )
+})
+
+describe("tool.finish – reviewer availability matches the dispatch context", () => {
+  it.instance(
+    "a config task deny blocks success at medium on every repeat, and only an honest failure report delivers",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        // Medium requires a reviewer: an unavailable one blocks success on
+        // every repeat (no decline loop) and never reads as approval.
+        const first = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id)).pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(blockedMessage(first)).toContain("Review blocked (permission-denied)")
+        const second = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id)).pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(blockedMessage(second)).toContain("Review blocked (permission-denied)")
+
+        // Only an honest failure report can complete the turn.
+        const reported = yield* def.execute({ reason: "failure", result: "Review cannot run" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).termination).toBe("review-blocked")
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).unavailable).toBe("permission-denied")
+      }),
+    { config: { permission: { task: { review: "deny" } } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "a session-scoped task deny also blocks success at medium",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession({
+          permission: [{ action: "deny", permission: "task", pattern: "review" }],
+        })
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const exit = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id)).pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(blockedMessage(exit)).toContain("Review blocked (permission-denied)")
+        const reported = yield* def.execute({ reason: "failure", result: "Review cannot run" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).termination).toBe("review-blocked")
+      }),
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "the subagent depth limit blocks success at medium, never approval",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const exit = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id)).pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(blockedMessage(exit)).toContain("Review blocked (subagent-depth)")
+        const reported = yield* def.execute({ reason: "failure", result: "Review cannot run" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).termination).toBe("review-blocked")
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).unavailable).toBe("subagent-depth")
+      }),
+    { config: { subagent_depth: 0 } },
+  )
+})
+
+describe("tool.finish – availability uses the calling agent's dispatch ruleset", () => {
+  // Real dispatch parity: compose exactly the inputs the live path uses —
+  // task.ts's requested+resolved pattern pair, evaluated through the
+  // ctx.ask ruleset from session/tools.ts (the running agent's permissions
+  // merged with the session's) — and run them through the REAL Permission
+  // service, so the probe can never bypass evaluation with a stub.
+  const dispatchGate = Effect.fn("AgentEffortTest.dispatchGate")(function* (
+    chat: Session.Info,
+    caller: Agent.Info,
+    patterns: string[],
+  ) {
+    const permission = yield* Permission.Service
+    return yield* permission
+      .ask({
+        permission: "task",
+        patterns,
+        always: ["*"],
+        metadata: { description: "review dispatch parity probe" },
+        sessionID: chat.id,
+        ruleset: Permission.merge(caller.permission, chat.permission ?? []),
+      })
+      .pipe(Effect.exit)
+  })
+
+  const expectDenied = (exit: Exit.Exit<void, PermissionV1.Error>) => {
+    expect(Exit.isFailure(exit)).toBe(true)
+    if (!Exit.isFailure(exit)) return
+    expect(Cause.squash(exit.cause)).toBeInstanceOf(PermissionV1.DeniedError)
+  }
+
+  it.instance(
+    "a running-agent-scoped task deny blocks success at medium on every repeat, matching real dispatch denial",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const agents = yield* Agent.Service
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        // The caller is the agent running finish, and its own ruleset is
+        // what gates dispatch.
+        const caller = yield* agents.get("work")
+        expect(Permission.evaluate("task", "review", caller!.permission).action).toBe("deny")
+
+        const first = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id)).pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(blockedMessage(first)).toContain("Review blocked (permission-denied)")
+        const second = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id)).pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(blockedMessage(second)).toContain("Review blocked (permission-denied)")
+
+        // The real dispatch gate reaches the same verdict: the routed pair
+        // is denied under the caller's composition.
+        const exit = yield* dispatchGate(chat, caller!, ["review", "work-review"])
+        expectDenied(exit)
+
+        const reported = yield* def.execute({ reason: "failure", result: "Review cannot run" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).termination).toBe("review-blocked")
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).unavailable).toBe("permission-denied")
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { work: { permission: { task: { review: "deny" } } } } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "a generic review-agent-scoped task deny does not release a permitted caller's required review",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const agents = yield* Agent.Service
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        // The generic reviewer's OWN ruleset denies task delegation...
+        const requested = yield* agents.get("review")
+        expect(Permission.evaluate("task", "review", requested!.permission).action).toBe("deny")
+        // ...which is not part of the caller's dispatch composition.
+        const caller = yield* agents.get("work")
+        expect(Permission.evaluate("task", "review", caller!.permission).action).toBe("allow")
+
+        // Real dispatch from the caller completes without a denial (and
+        // without ever creating a pending prompt).
+        const gate = yield* dispatchGate(chat, caller!, ["review", "work-review"])
+        expect(Exit.isSuccess(gate)).toBe(true)
+
+        // finish still demands the required review instead of mislabelling
+        // the turn review-unavailable and delivering without one.
+        const attempts: Array<{ review?: Record<string, unknown> }> = []
+        const declined = yield* def
+          .execute(
+            { reason: "success", result: "done" },
+            {
+              ...finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+              metadata: (val) => {
+                attempts.push(val.metadata as { review?: Record<string, unknown> })
+                return Effect.void
+              },
+            },
+          )
+          .pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(Exit.isFailure(declined)).toBe(true)
+        if (!Exit.isFailure(declined)) return
+        expect(Cause.squash(declined.cause)).toBeInstanceOf(ToolFailure)
+        expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1)
+        expect(attempts[0]?.review).toMatchObject({ nudged: true, disposition: "unreviewed" })
+        expect("unavailableReason" in (attempts[0]?.review ?? {})).toBe(false)
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { review: { permission: { task: { "*": "deny" } } } } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "a deny on the routed reviewer pattern blocks success at medium through the caller's ruleset",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const agents = yield* Agent.Service
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        // work routes a generic review to work-review, so only the routed
+        // pattern is denied for this caller; the generic one is untouched.
+        const caller = yield* agents.get("work")
+        expect(Permission.evaluate("task", "review", caller!.permission).action).toBe("allow")
+        expect(Permission.evaluate("task", "work-review", caller!.permission).action).toBe("deny")
+
+        const exit = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id)).pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(blockedMessage(exit)).toContain("Review blocked (permission-denied)")
+
+        const gate = yield* dispatchGate(chat, caller!, ["review", "work-review"])
+        expectDenied(gate)
+
+        const reported = yield* def.execute({ reason: "failure", result: "Review cannot run" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).termination).toBe("review-blocked")
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).unavailable).toBe("permission-denied")
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { work: { permission: { task: { "work-review": "deny" } } } } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "an always-grant masks a later deny: dispatch stays allowed while finish still demands its required review",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const permission = yield* Permission.Service
+        const agents = yield* Agent.Service
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+        const caller = yield* agents.get("work")
+
+        // The always-allow is granted while no deny rule is in force; the
+        // instance-approved state outlives the ruleset it was granted under,
+        // exactly as ask() + reply("always") create it.
+        const granting = yield* seedSession({ title: "granting" })
+        const grant = yield* permission
+          .ask({
+            permission: "task",
+            patterns: ["review"],
+            always: ["*"],
+            metadata: { description: "review dispatch" },
+            sessionID: granting.chat.id,
+            ruleset: [],
+          })
+          .pipe(Effect.forkScoped)
+        const pendingRequest = yield* pollWithTimeout(
+          Effect.gen(function* () {
+            const pending = yield* permission.list()
+            return pending[0]
+          }),
+          "the review permission ask never became pending",
+        )
+        yield* permission.reply({ requestID: pendingRequest.id, reply: "always" })
+        yield* Fiber.join(grant)
+
+        // The deny exists now, on the session finish runs in.
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession({
+          title: "denied",
+          permission: [{ action: "deny", permission: "task", pattern: "review" }],
+        })
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+
+        // Actual dispatch remains allowed: Permission.ask evaluates the
+        // approved grant last, masking the session deny.
+        const gate = yield* dispatchGate(chat, caller!, ["review", "work-review"])
+        expect(Exit.isSuccess(gate)).toBe(true)
+
+        // finish must still demand its required review instead of claiming
+        // review-unavailable — the mandatory-review escape a masked deny
+        // would otherwise create.
+        const attempts: Array<{ review?: Record<string, unknown> }> = []
+        const declined = yield* def
+          .execute(
+            { reason: "success", result: "done" },
+            {
+              ...finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+              metadata: (val) => {
+                attempts.push(val.metadata as { review?: Record<string, unknown> })
+                return Effect.void
+              },
+            },
+          )
+          .pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(Exit.isFailure(declined)).toBe(true)
+        if (!Exit.isFailure(declined)) return
+        expect(Cause.squash(declined.cause)).toBeInstanceOf(ToolFailure)
+        expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1)
+        expect(attempts[0]?.review).toMatchObject({ nudged: true, disposition: "unreviewed" })
+        expect("unavailableReason" in (attempts[0]?.review ?? {})).toBe(false)
+      }),
+    30_000,
+  )
+})
+
+describe("tool.finish – newest-50 routing window parity with task dispatch", () => {
+  // task's unpinned reviewer fallback reads only the newest 50 messages
+  // (sessions.messages({limit:50})); finish takes its fallback from the same
+  // window. These fixtures push the newest user row outside that window the
+  // way a long turn does: one user message, then >50 assistant rows.
+  const APPROVED = [
+    "<alphacode-review>",
+    JSON.stringify({
+      version: 1,
+      revision: "uncommitted",
+      assessment: "approved",
+      summary: "clean",
+      findings: [],
+    }),
+    "</alphacode-review>",
+  ].join("\n")
+
+  it.instance(
+    "task's real dispatch asks generic review outside the window while finish still demands its review",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const permission = yield* Permission.Service
+        const agents = yield* Agent.Service
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        const caller = yield* agents.get("work")
+        expect(caller).toBeDefined()
+        if (!caller) return
+
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession({ title: "window" })
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        yield* fillAssistantRows(chat.id, assistant.id, 54)
+
+        const seeded = yield* sessions.get(chat.id)
+        expect(seeded.agent ?? null).toBeNull()
+
+        // Actual dispatch: task's real execution. The ctx.ask shim records
+        // the real pattern set and forwards to the REAL Permission.ask under
+        // the session/tools.ts caller composition (agent + session rules).
+        const asked: string[][] = []
+        const promptOps: TaskPromptOps = {
+          ...stubOps(),
+          prompt: (input) =>
+            Effect.sync(() => {
+              const replied = reply(input)
+              const now = Date.now()
+              const finishPart: SessionV1.ToolPart = {
+                id: PartID.ascending(),
+                messageID: replied.info.id,
+                sessionID: input.sessionID,
+                type: "tool",
+                tool: "finish",
+                callID: "finish-call",
+                state: {
+                  status: "completed",
+                  input: { result: APPROVED },
+                  output: APPROVED,
+                  title: "finish",
+                  metadata: {},
+                  time: { start: now, end: now },
+                },
+              }
+              return { ...replied, parts: [...replied.parts, finishPart] }
+            }),
+        }
+        const tool = yield* TaskTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+        const result = yield* def.execute(
+          { description: "review the change", prompt: "review it", subagent_type: "review", background: false },
+          {
+            sessionID: chat.id,
+            messageID: assistant.id,
+            agent: "work",
+            abort: new AbortController().signal,
+            extra: { promptOps },
+            messages: [],
+            metadata: () => Effect.void,
+            ask: (input) =>
+              Effect.gen(function* () {
+                asked.push([...input.patterns])
+                yield* permission
+                  .ask({
+                    ...input,
+                    sessionID: chat.id,
+                    ruleset: Permission.merge(caller.permission, chat.permission ?? []),
+                  })
+                  .pipe(Effect.orDie)
+              }),
+          },
+        )
+
+        // task's actual routing: its window holds no user row, so the request
+        // stayed generic — exactly one ask under ["review"] — and task itself
+        // recorded the delivered report for the generic reviewer.
+        expect(asked).toEqual([["review"]])
+        expect(present(result.metadata.review).revision).toBe("uncommitted")
+        const child = yield* sessions.get(result.metadata.sessionId as SessionID)
+        expect(child.agent).toBe("review")
+
+        // The same real Permission.ask permits the observed dispatch patterns.
+        const gate = yield* permission
+          .ask({
+            permission: "task",
+            patterns: asked[0] ?? [],
+            always: ["*"],
+            metadata: { description: "window parity probe" },
+            sessionID: chat.id,
+            ruleset: Permission.merge(caller.permission, chat.permission ?? []),
+          })
+          .pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(Exit.isSuccess(gate)).toBe(true)
+
+        // finish must demand its required review — not claim the specialist
+        // is unavailable while the actual dispatch would ask only generic
+        // review, which the same ruleset allows.
+        const attempts: Array<{ review?: Record<string, unknown> }> = []
+        const finishTool = yield* FinishTool
+        const fdef = yield* finishTool.init()
+        const declined = yield* fdef
+          .execute(
+            { reason: "success", result: "done" },
+            {
+              ...finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+              metadata: (val) => {
+                attempts.push(val.metadata as { review?: Record<string, unknown> })
+                return Effect.void
+              },
+            },
+          )
+          .pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(Exit.isFailure(declined)).toBe(true)
+        if (!Exit.isFailure(declined)) return
+        expect(Cause.squash(declined.cause)).toBeInstanceOf(ToolFailure)
+        expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1)
+        expect(attempts[0]?.review).toMatchObject({ nudged: true, disposition: "unreviewed" })
+        expect("unavailableReason" in (attempts[0]?.review ?? {})).toBe(false)
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { work: { permission: { task: { "work-review": "deny" } } } } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "a pinned session agent still routes the specialist outside the window and blocks success",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession({ title: "pinned", agent: "code", pinnedAgent: "work" })
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        yield* fillAssistantRows(chat.id, assistant.id, 54)
+
+        const seeded = yield* sessions.get(chat.id)
+        expect(seeded.agent).toBe("work")
+
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+        const exit = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id)).pipe(Effect.exit)
+
+        // The window holds no user row, so only the pinned tier can route:
+        // the specialist deny blocks honestly instead of degrading to the
+        // generic reviewer.
+        expect(blockedMessage(exit)).toContain("Review blocked (permission-denied)")
+        const reported = yield* def.execute({ reason: "failure", result: "Review cannot run" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).termination).toBe("review-blocked")
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).unavailable).toBe("permission-denied")
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { work: { permission: { task: { "work-review": "deny" } } } } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "the newest user row inside the window still specializes the reviewer and blocks success",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession({ title: "in-window" })
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+        // 49 rows after the user row keeps it as the oldest row of the
+        // 50-row window, exactly the boundary task would still see.
+        yield* fillAssistantRows(chat.id, assistant.id, 48)
+
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+        const exit = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id)).pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(blockedMessage(exit)).toContain("Review blocked (permission-denied)")
+        const reported = yield* def.execute({ reason: "failure", result: "Review cannot run" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).termination).toBe("review-blocked")
+        expect(present(reported.metadata.review).unavailable).toBe("permission-denied")
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { work: { permission: { task: { "work-review": "deny" } } } } } },
+  )
+
+  it.instance("review accounting still reads history older than the routing window", () =>
+    Effect.gen(function* () {
+      const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession({ title: "accounting" })
+      yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "edit")
+      yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "task", { subagent_type: "review", background: false }, APPROVED)
+      // The approved review now sits outside the newest-50 window; the
+      // full-history read behind reviewLoopState must still count it —
+      // the routing window must not truncate accounting.
+      yield* fillAssistantRows(chat.id, assistant.id, 54)
+
+      const tool = yield* FinishTool
+      const def = yield* tool.init()
+      const result = yield* def.execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+
+      expect(present(result.metadata.review)).toMatchObject({
+        effort: "medium",
+        disposition: "reviewed",
+        termination: "approved",
+        reviews: 1,
+      })
+    }),
+  )
+})
+
+describe("tool.finish – background child accounting", () => {
+  it.instance(
+    "a pending background child exempts the write-free turn; its completed writes are then accounted",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        // The dispatched background task has not reported yet: its part
+        // declares no writes, so this turn is write-free and exempt.
+        yield* addToolPart(chat.id, assistant.id, "task", { subagent_type: "general", background: true }, "started")
+        const tool = yield* FinishTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const pending = yield* def.execute(
+          { reason: "success", result: "kicked off" },
+          finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+        expect(present(pending.metadata.review).termination).toBe("not-required")
+
+        // Once the child's completion notification lands, its delegated
+        // writes are real work: the next finish is gated like any other.
+        yield* Effect.gen(function* () {
+          const now = Date.now()
+          yield* sessions.updatePart({
+            id: PartID.ascending(),
+            messageID: assistant.id,
+            sessionID: chat.id,
+            type: "text",
+            synthetic: true,
+            text: "Background task completed",
+            metadata: { [REVIEW_LOOP_METADATA]: { writesFiles: true } },
+            time: { start: now, end: now },
+          })
+        })
+
+        const exit = yield* def
+          .execute({ reason: "success", result: "done" }, finishContext(chat.id, assistant.id))
+          .pipe(Effect.exit)
+        expect(Exit.isFailure(exit)).toBe(true)
+        if (!Exit.isFailure(exit)) return
+        const failure = exit.cause.reasons.find(Cause.isFailReason)?.error
+        expect(failure).toBeInstanceOf(ToolFailure)
+      }),
+    { config: { agent: { effort: "medium" } } },
+  )
+})
+
+describe("tool.task – effort selection lifecycle", () => {
+  const taskContext = (chat: SessionID, message: MessageID, ops = stubOps()) => ({
+    sessionID: chat,
+    messageID: message,
+    agent: "work",
+    abort: new AbortController().signal,
+    extra: { promptOps: ops },
+    messages: [],
+    metadata: () => Effect.void,
+    ask: () => Effect.void,
+  })
+
+  it.instance(
+    "an explicit override persists on the new child and is published in task metadata",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        const tool = yield* TaskTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const result = yield* def.execute(
+          { description: "do it", prompt: "implement the feature", subagent_type: "general", effort: "thorough" },
+          taskContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+
+        const childID = result.metadata.sessionId as SessionID
+        expect(result.metadata.effort).toBe("thorough")
+        const child = yield* sessions.get(childID)
+        expect(readAgentEffort(child.metadata)).toBe("thorough")
+      }),
+    30_000,
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "a new child inherits the parent's persisted level when the override is omitted",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession({ title: "parent", metadata: { agentEffort: "fast" } })
+        const tool = yield* TaskTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const result = yield* def.execute(
+          { description: "do it", prompt: "implement the feature", subagent_type: "general" },
+          taskContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+
+        expect(result.metadata.effort).toBe("fast")
+        const child = yield* sessions.get(result.metadata.sessionId as SessionID)
+        expect(readAgentEffort(child.metadata)).toBe("fast")
+      }),
+    30_000,
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "siblings keep independent selections",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession({ title: "parent", metadata: { agentEffort: "fast" } })
+        const tool = yield* TaskTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const thorough = yield* def.execute(
+          { description: "a", prompt: "work a", subagent_type: "general", effort: "thorough" },
+          taskContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+        const inheriting = yield* def.execute(
+          { description: "b", prompt: "work b", subagent_type: "general" },
+          taskContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+
+        const thoroughChild = yield* sessions.get(thorough.metadata.sessionId as SessionID)
+        const inheritingChild = yield* sessions.get(inheriting.metadata.sessionId as SessionID)
+        expect(readAgentEffort(thoroughChild.metadata)).toBe("thorough")
+        expect(readAgentEffort(inheritingChild.metadata)).toBe("fast")
+      }),
+    30_000,
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "resume keeps an omitted selection and allows an explicit change",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        const tool = yield* TaskTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const first = yield* def.execute(
+          { description: "a", prompt: "work a", subagent_type: "general", effort: "thorough" },
+          taskContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+        const childID = first.metadata.sessionId as SessionID
+
+        const resumed = yield* def.execute(
+          { description: "a", prompt: "continue", subagent_type: "general", task_id: childID },
+          taskContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+        expect(resumed.metadata.effort).toBe("thorough")
+        const kept = yield* sessions.get(childID)
+        expect(readAgentEffort(kept.metadata)).toBe("thorough")
+
+        const changed = yield* def.execute(
+          { description: "a", prompt: "continue", subagent_type: "general", task_id: childID, effort: "fast" },
+          taskContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+        expect(changed.metadata.effort).toBe("fast")
+        const updated = yield* sessions.get(childID)
+        expect(readAgentEffort(updated.metadata)).toBe("fast")
+      }),
+    30_000,
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "a foreign child is neither read nor written and its effort is omitted from metadata",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        const other = yield* sessions.create({ title: "Other parent" })
+        const child = yield* sessions.create({ parentID: other.id, title: "Foreign child" })
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        const tool = yield* TaskTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const result = yield* def.execute(
+          {
+            description: "a",
+            prompt: "continue foreign work",
+            subagent_type: "general",
+            task_id: child.id,
+            effort: "thorough",
+          },
+          taskContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+
+        // The override was not applied, so publishing it would be dishonest.
+        expect("effort" in result.metadata).toBe(false)
+        const foreign = yield* sessions.get(child.id)
+        expect(readAgentEffort(foreign.metadata)).toBeUndefined()
+      }),
+    30_000,
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "a background dispatch persists the level before the run starts",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        const { chat, assistant } = yield* seedSession()
+        const tool = yield* TaskTool
+        const def = yield* tool.init()
+
+        const result = yield* def.execute(
+          {
+            description: "a",
+            prompt: "long running work",
+            subagent_type: "general",
+            effort: "thorough",
+            background: true,
+          },
+          taskContext(chat.id, assistant.id),
+        )
+
+        expect(result.metadata.background).toBe(true)
+        expect(result.metadata.effort).toBe("thorough")
+        const child = yield* sessions.get(result.metadata.sessionId as SessionID)
+        expect(readAgentEffort(child.metadata)).toBe("thorough")
+      }),
+    30_000,
+  )
+
+  it.instance(
+    "fork preserves the persisted selection and fork edits stay independent",
+    () =>
+      Effect.gen(function* () {
+        const sessions = yield* Session.Service
+        const { chat } = yield* seedSession({ title: "original", metadata: { agentEffort: "thorough" } })
+
+        const forked = yield* sessions.fork({ sessionID: chat.id })
+        expect(readAgentEffort(forked.metadata)).toBe("thorough")
+
+        yield* sessions.setMetadata({
+          sessionID: forked.id,
+          metadata: { ...(forked.metadata ?? {}), agentEffort: "fast" },
+        })
+        const rereadFork = yield* sessions.get(forked.id)
+        const rereadOriginal = yield* sessions.get(chat.id)
+        expect(readAgentEffort(rereadFork.metadata)).toBe("fast")
+        expect(readAgentEffort(rereadOriginal.metadata)).toBe("thorough")
+      }),
+    30_000,
+  )
+})

+++ b/packages/schema/src/agent-effort.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+export * as AgentEffort from "./agent-effort"
+
+import { Schema } from "effect"
+
+/** Ordered agent-effort levels: least to most process. */
+export const levels = ["fast", "medium", "thorough"] as const
+
+export type Level = (typeof levels)[number]
+
+/** Closed schema for a persisted or configured agent-effort level. */
+export const Level = Schema.Literals(levels).annotate({ identifier: "AgentEffort.Level" })
+
+/**
+ * Safely resolves an untrusted value to an effort level.
+ *
+ * Invalid or missing values fall back to `fallback`, and an invalid (or
+ * absent) fallback falls back to `medium` — the ultimate default — so callers
+ * always receive a usable level without throwing on untrusted input.
+ */
+export function resolve(value: unknown, fallback?: Level): Level {
+  return levels.includes(value as Level) ? (value as Level) : (fallback ?? "medium")
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import { createMemo } from "solid-js"
+import { useLocal } from "../context/local"
+import { useTheme } from "../context/theme"
+import { DialogSelect } from "../ui/dialog-select"
+import { useDialog } from "../ui/dialog"
+import type { Level } from "../util/agent-effort"
+
+const ENTRIES: {
+  value: Level
+  title: string
+  description: string
+  details: string[]
+}[] = [
+  {
+    value: "fast",
+    title: "Fast",
+    description: "no review ritual",
+    details: ["Inline self-check and syntax/smoke validation, delivered with an honest unreviewed label"],
+  },
+  {
+    value: "medium",
+    title: "Medium",
+    description: "up to 2 review passes · default",
+    details: ["Independent review for code changes; only blocking findings force another pass, then an honest status"],
+  },
+  {
+    value: "thorough",
+    title: "Thorough",
+    description: "review until clean",
+    details: ["Structured review contract with severity-driven convergence and full validation gates, no pass cap"],
+  },
+]
+
+export function DialogAgentEffort() {
+  const local = useLocal()
+  const dialog = useDialog()
+  const { theme } = useTheme()
+
+  const options = createMemo(() =>
+    ENTRIES.map((entry) => ({
+      value: entry.value,
+      title: entry.title,
+      description: entry.description,
+      details: entry.details,
+      onSelect: () => {
+        dialog.clear()
+        local.effort.set(entry.value)
+      },
+    })),
+  )
+
+  return (
+    <DialogSelect<Level>
+      options={options()}
+      title="Agent effort"
+      current={local.effort.current()}
+      flat={true}
+      footer={
+        <text fg={theme.textMuted}>
+          {local.effort.scoped()
+            ? "Stored on this session · separate from model thinking"
+            : "Config default · open a session to change it"}
+        </text>
+      }
+    />
+  )
+}

+// Effective effort for the active session: a pending local write wins over
+// the synced row, the persisted session selection wins over configuration,
+// and configuration wins over the schema default. A session without a row
+// (a brand-new session) falls straight through to configuration, so new work
+// starts from the configured default and a lookup can never leak another
+// session's pending selection into the current one.
+export function effortSelection(input: { override?: unknown; metadata?: unknown; config?: unknown }): Level {
+  return metadataLevel(input.override) ?? resolveEffort({ metadata: input.metadata, config: input.config })
+}
+
+// Computes the session metadata update for a selection. Returns undefined
+// when the effective record already carries the level, which keeps repeated
+// selections idempotent. The merge base unions the pending overlay over the
+// synced row so two rapid selections cannot lose the first write (or any
+// concurrently synced key) before its sync event lands.
+export function effortUpdateFor(input: { sessionID: string; override?: unknown; metadata?: unknown; level: Level }) {
+  const base =
+    input.override !== undefined && input.metadata !== undefined
+      ? { ...(isRecord(input.metadata) ? input.metadata : {}), ...(isRecord(input.override) ? input.override : {}) }
+      : (input.override ?? input.metadata)
+  if (metadataLevel(base) === input.level) return undefined
+  return { sessionID: input.sessionID, metadata: mergeEffortMetadata(base, input.level) }
+}

@@ -538,6 +623,102 @@ export const { use: useLocal, provider: LocalProvider } = createSimpleContext({
 
     const session = createSession()
 
+    function createEffort() {
+      // Session-scoped optimistic metadata overlay. Entries are keyed by
+      // session ID, so a selection made in one session can never surface in
+      // another, and each write merges over the synced row (session.update
+      // replaces metadata wholesale) until the server event confirms it.
+      const pending = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>()
+      const [pendingVersion, setPendingVersion] = createSignal(0)
+
+      function activeSessionID() {
+        return route.data.type === "session" ? route.data.sessionID : undefined
+      }
+
+      // Drop overlay entries once the synced row reflects the written level;
+      // the row becomes the source of truth again at that point.
+      createEffect(() => {
+        pendingVersion()
+        for (const [sessionID, metadata] of pending) {
+          const row = sync.session.get(sessionID)
+          if (row && metadataLevel(row.metadata) === metadataLevel(metadata)) pending.delete(sessionID)
+        }
+      })
+
+      return {
+        current(): Level {
+          const sessionID = activeSessionID()
+          const row = sessionID ? sync.session.get(sessionID) : undefined
+          // Subscribe renders to the optimistic overlay: a pending local
+          // write must be visible immediately, before the sync event that
+          // confirms it lands on the session row.
+          pendingVersion()
+          return effortSelection({
+            override: sessionID ? pending.get(sessionID) : undefined,
+            metadata: row?.metadata,
+            config: sync.data.config,
+          })
+        },
+        // Whether the selection is session-scoped right now. On the home
+        // route there is no session to persist into, so the configured
+        // default stays authoritative for new work.
+        scoped() {
+          return activeSessionID() !== undefined
+        },
+        set(level: Level) {
+          const sessionID = activeSessionID()
+          if (!sessionID) {
+            toast.show({
+              variant: "info",
+              message: "Agent effort applies per session; open a session to change it.",
+              duration: 3000,
+            })
+            return
+          }
+          const row = sync.session.get(sessionID)
+          if (!row) {
+            toast.show({
+              variant: "warning",
+              message: "Session is still loading; agent effort unchanged.",
+              duration: 3000,
+            })
+            return
+          }
+          const update = effortUpdateFor({
+            sessionID,
+            override: pending.get(sessionID),
+            metadata: row.metadata,
+            level,
+          })
+          if (update) {
+            pending.set(sessionID, update.metadata)
+            setPendingVersion((version) => version + 1)
+            void sdk.client.session
+              .update({ sessionID, metadata: update.metadata }, { throwOnError: true })
+              .catch((error) => {
+                // Only roll back this write: a newer selection may already
+                // have replaced the overlay for the same session.
+                if (pending.get(sessionID) === update.metadata) {
+                  pending.delete(sessionID)
+                  setPendingVersion((version) => version + 1)
+                }
+                toast.show({
+                  variant: "warning",
+                  message: `Failed to save agent effort: ${errorMessage(error)}`,
+                  duration: 3000,
+                })
+              })
+          }
+          model.variant.couple(level)
+        },
+        cycle() {
+          this.set(nextLevel(this.current()))
+        },
+      }
+    }
+
+    const effort = createEffort()
+

       isEnabled(name: string) {
         const status = sync.data.mcp[name]

diff --git a/packages/tui/src/util/agent-effort.ts b/packages/tui/src/util/agent-effort.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..c4d9b427b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/tui/src/util/agent-effort.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,235 @@
+import { AgentEffort } from "@opencode-ai/schema/agent-effort"
+
+export type Level = AgentEffort.Level
+
+/** The session metadata key that stores the persisted per-session selection. */
+export const METADATA_KEY = "agentEffort"
+
+// Coupled thinking defaults: effort is its own dial, but an untouched
+// thinking selector follows the process level when the model offers it.
+const COUPLED_THINKING: Record<Level, string> = {
+  fast: "low",
+  medium: "medium",
+  thorough: "high",
+}
+
+/** Narrow for the open metadata/config records read from untrusted input. */
+export function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
+}
+
+function isLevel(value: unknown): value is Level {
+  return AgentEffort.levels.includes(value as Level)
+}
+
+/** Cycles fast → medium → thorough → fast for the local effort dial. */
+export function nextLevel(level: Level): Level {
+  const index = AgentEffort.levels.indexOf(level)
+  // The shared resolver is the agreed fallback contract: a valid level always
+  // wraps to the next ordered level, and anything else lands on medium.
+  return AgentEffort.resolve(AgentEffort.levels[(index + 1) % AgentEffort.levels.length])
+}
+
+function finiteCount(value: unknown): number | undefined {
+  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : undefined
+}
+
+// Pass counts are meaningful at zero (a fast delivery really did zero
+// review passes), unlike finding counts.
+function passCount(value: unknown): number | undefined {
+  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : undefined
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reads the persisted selection out of an untrusted session metadata record.
+ * Metadata is an open record, so only a closed literal is ever accepted and
+ * anything else behaves as "no persisted selection".
+ */
+export function metadataLevel(metadata: unknown): Level | undefined {
+  if (!isRecord(metadata)) return undefined
+  const raw = metadata[METADATA_KEY]
+  return isLevel(raw) ? raw : undefined
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reads the reserved scalar `agent.effort` configuration setting. Named agent
+ * objects are never enumerated here: a non-scalar `effort` entry (a legacy
+ * named agent) or any invalid value is ignored rather than trusted.
+ */
+export function configLevel(config: unknown): Level | undefined {
+  if (!isRecord(config)) return undefined
+  const agent = config.agent
+  if (!isRecord(agent)) return undefined
+  const raw = agent.effort
+  return isLevel(raw) ? raw : undefined
+}
+
+/**
+ * Effective level precedence for the TUI: an explicit persisted session
+ * selection, then the configured default, then the schema fallback (medium).
+ * Invalid or missing values fall through to the next source instead of being
+ * trusted, so an unknown session value never masks the configured default.
+ */
+export function resolveEffort(input: { metadata?: unknown; config?: unknown; fallback?: Level }): Level {
+  return metadataLevel(input.metadata) ?? configLevel(input.config) ?? AgentEffort.resolve(undefined, input.fallback)
+}
+
+/**
+ * `session.update` replaces the metadata record wholesale, so every effort
+ * write merges over the current record to preserve unrelated keys. A
+ * non-record base (missing/corrupted metadata) collapses to the single key.
+ */
+export function mergeEffortMetadata(current: unknown, level: Level): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const base = isRecord(current) ? current : {}
+  return { ...base, [METADATA_KEY]: level }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Coupled thinking default for an effort change. It is only ever a default:
+ * it applies when nothing else has chosen a thinking variant for this model
+ * (no explicit selector choice, including explicit default/off, and no
+ * configured agent/model variant) and the model actually offers the coupled
+ * variant. Unsupported combinations return undefined so the model keeps its
+ * normal behavior.
+ */
+export function coupledThinking(input: {
+  effort: Level
+  variants?: readonly string[]
+  chosen?: string | undefined
+  configured?: string | undefined
+}): string | undefined {
+  if (input.chosen !== undefined) return undefined
+  if (input.configured !== undefined && input.configured !== "") return undefined
+  const wanted = COUPLED_THINKING[input.effort]
+  return input.variants?.includes(wanted) ? wanted : undefined
+}
+
+export type FinishTone = "success" | "warning" | "text"
+
+export type FinishStatusLine = {
+  label: string
+  detail?: string
+  tone: FinishTone
+}
+
+export type FinishStatus = {
+  review?: FinishStatusLine
+  validation?: FinishStatusLine
+}
+
+const TERMINATION_LABELS: Record<string, FinishStatusLine> = {
+  approved: { label: "approved", tone: "success" },
+  unreviewed: { label: "unreviewed", tone: "warning" },
+  "findings-open": { label: "findings open", tone: "warning" },
+  "budget-exhausted": { label: "budget exhausted", tone: "warning" },
+  "review-unavailable": { label: "review unavailable", tone: "warning" },
+  "not-required": { label: "not required", tone: "text" },
+  waiting: { label: "waiting", tone: "text" },
+  // Historical transcript labels stay readable for older finish results.
+  "review-cap": { label: "cap", tone: "warning" },
+  skipped: { label: "skipped", tone: "warning" },
+}
+
+function reviewLine(review: Record<string, unknown>): FinishStatusLine | undefined {
+  const termination = typeof review.termination === "string" ? review.termination : undefined
+  const mapped = termination ? TERMINATION_LABELS[termination] : undefined
+  const disposition =
+    review.disposition === "reviewed" || review.disposition === "unreviewed" ? review.disposition : undefined
+  const verdict = typeof review.verdict === "string" ? review.verdict : undefined
+
+  const label =
+    mapped?.label ??
+    termination ??
+    (disposition === "unreviewed" ? "unreviewed" : disposition) ??
+    (verdict === "approved" ? "approved" : verdict)
+  if (!label) return undefined
+  const tone: FinishTone =
+    mapped?.tone ??
+    (disposition === "unreviewed" || verdict === "needs-fixes" || verdict === "cap" ? "warning" : "text")
+
+  const detail: string[] = []
+  const effort = review.effort
+  if (typeof effort === "string" && effort) detail.push(effort)
+
+  const reviews = passCount(review.reviews)
+  const maxIterations =
+    typeof review.maxIterations === "number" && Number.isFinite(review.maxIterations) && review.maxIterations > 0
+      ? review.maxIterations
+      : undefined
+  // A pass count is never rendered as an infinite budget: thorough results
+  // carry a count without a limit instead of serializing Infinity.
+  if (reviews !== undefined) {
+    detail.push(
+      maxIterations !== undefined
+        ? `${reviews}/${maxIterations} passes`
+        : `${reviews} ${reviews === 1 ? "pass" : "passes"}`,
+    )
+  } else if (maxIterations !== undefined) {
+    detail.push(`max ${maxIterations} passes`)
+  }
+
+  const open = finiteCount(review.openFindings)
+  const blocking = finiteCount(review.blockingFindings)
+  if (open !== undefined) detail.push(blocking !== undefined ? `${open} open, ${blocking} blocking` : `${open} open`)
+  else if (blocking !== undefined) detail.push(`${blocking} blocking`)
+
+  if (review.workSinceReview === true || (typeof review.workSinceReview === "number" && review.workSinceReview > 0)) {
+    detail.push("stale")
+  }
+
+  const reason = review.unavailableReason
+  if (typeof reason === "string" && reason.trim()) detail.push(reason.trim())
+
+  return { label, detail: detail.length ? detail.join(" · ") : undefined, tone }
+}
+
+function validationLine(validation: Record<string, unknown>): FinishStatusLine {
+  const status =
+    validation.status === "passed" || validation.status === "failed" || validation.status === "incomplete"
+      ? validation.status
+      : undefined
+  const label = status ? `validation ${status}` : "validation"
+
+  const detail: string[] = []
+  const gate = validation.gate
+  if (typeof gate === "string" && gate) detail.push(gate)
+
+  // Missing/failed/not-run/unavailable evidence stays visible: only checks
+  // that actually reported passing are left out of the summary line.
+  const checks = Array.isArray(validation.checks) ? validation.checks : []
+  for (const check of checks) {
+    if (!isRecord(check)) continue
+    if (check.status === "passed") continue
+    const category = typeof check.category === "string" && check.category ? check.category : "check"
+    detail.push(typeof check.status === "string" && check.status ? `${category}: ${check.status}` : category)
+  }
+
+  const tone: FinishTone = status === "passed" ? "success" : status === "failed" ? "warning" : "text"
+  return { label, detail: detail.length ? detail.join(" · ") : undefined, tone }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Honest finish status for the rendered `finish` tool part. Legacy
+ * transcripts keep their historical labels, exhaustive/open/stale/unavailable
+ * results are never upgraded to approval, and an absent review/validation
+ * record returns undefined so old finish rendering stays untouched.
+ */
+export function finishStatus(metadata: unknown): FinishStatus | undefined {
+  if (!isRecord(metadata)) return undefined
+  const review = isRecord(metadata.review) ? reviewLine(metadata.review) : undefined
+  const validation = isRecord(metadata.validation) ? validationLine(metadata.validation) : undefined
+  if (!review && !validation) return undefined
+  return { review, validation }
+}
+
+/** Renders the honest status as transcript lines beneath the finish summary. */
+export function finishStatusLines(status: FinishStatus): string[] {
+  const lines: string[] = []
+  if (status.review) {
+    lines.push(`review: ${status.review.label}${status.review.detail ? ` · ${status.review.detail}` : ""}`)
+  }
+  if (status.validation) {
+    lines.push(`${status.validation.label}${status.validation.detail ? ` · ${status.validation.detail}` : ""}`)
+  }
+  return lines
+}

+/** @jsxImportSource @opentui/solid */
+import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test"
+import { createDefaultOpenTuiKeymap } from "@opentui/keymap/opentui"
+import { testRender, useRenderer } from "@opentui/solid"

+import { tmpdir } from "../../fixture/fixture"
+import { createTuiResolvedConfig } from "../../fixture/tui-runtime"
+import { createEventSource, createFetch, directory, json } from "../../fixture/tui-sdk"
