+type Setup = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof testRender>>
+
+const SESSION_THOROUGH = "ses_effort_thorough"
+const SESSION_FAST = "ses_effort_fast"
+const SESSION_PLAIN = "ses_effort_plain"
+
+function sessionRow(id: string, metadata?: Record<string, unknown>) {
+  return {
+    id,
+    slug: id,
+    title: `Session ${id}`,
+    projectID: "proj_test",
+    version: "0.0.0-test",
+    directory,
+    time: { created: 0, updated: 0 },
+    metadata,
+  }
+}
+
+function agentsPayload(agentVariant?: string, model?: { providerID: string; modelID: string }) {
+  return [
+    {
+      name: "build",
+      mode: "primary",
+      description: "Build agent",
+      permission: {},
+      options: {},
+      // A configured agent variant only applies when the agent's configured
+      // model is the active model, so the fixture pairs the variant with the
+      // model the harness actually selects.
+      ...(agentVariant && model ? { variant: agentVariant, model } : {}),
+    },
+  ]
+}
+
+function fullModel(id: string, name: string, variants?: Record<string, unknown>) {
+  return {
+    id,
+    providerID: "test-provider",
+    name,
+    capabilities: {
+      temperature: true,
+      reasoning: false,
+      attachment: false,
+      toolcall: true,
+      input: { text: true, audio: false, image: false, video: false, pdf: false },
+      output: { text: true, audio: false, image: false, video: false, pdf: false },
+      interleaved: false,
+    },
+    cost: { input: 1, output: 1, cache: { read: 0, write: 0 } },
+    limit: { context: 100_000, output: 8_192 },
+    status: "active",
+    options: {},
+    headers: {},
+    release_date: "2026-01-01",
+    ...(variants ? { variants } : {}),
+  }
+}
+
+function providersPayload() {
+  return {
+    providers: [
+      {
+        id: "test-provider",
+        name: "TestProvider",
+        source: "config",
+        env: [],
+        options: {},
+        models: {
+          "variant-model": fullModel("variant-model", "VariantModel", {
+            low: { reasoning_effort: "low" },
+            medium: { reasoning_effort: "medium" },
+            high: { reasoning_effort: "high" },
+          }),
+          "plain-model": fullModel("plain-model", "PlainModel"),
+        },
+      },
+    ],
+    default: { "test-provider": "variant-model" },
+  }
+}
+
+type Harness = {
+  app: Setup
+  local: ReturnType<typeof useLocal>
+  route: ReturnType<typeof useRoute>
+  sync: ReturnType<typeof useSync>
+  updates: { sessionID: string; body: Record<string, unknown> }[]
+  dispose: () => Promise<void>
+}
+
+async function mountEffort(input: {
+  route: Route
+  model: string
+  children: () => JSX.Element
+  agentVariant?: string
+}): Promise<Harness> {
+  const tmp = await tmpdir()
+  await Bun.write(`${tmp.path}/kv.json`, "{}")
+
+  const events = createEventSource()
+  const agentModel = parseModel(input.model)
+  const sessions = [
+    sessionRow(SESSION_THOROUGH, { agentEffort: "thorough", task: "keep-me" }),
+    sessionRow(SESSION_FAST, { agentEffort: "fast", task: "keep-me" }),
+    sessionRow(SESSION_PLAIN),
+  ]
+  const updates: { sessionID: string; body: Record<string, unknown> }[] = []
+
+  const calls = createFetch((url) => {
+    if (url.pathname === "/config") return json({ agent: { effort: "fast" } })
+    if (url.pathname === "/config/providers") return json(providersPayload())
+    if (url.pathname === "/agent") return json(agentsPayload(input.agentVariant, agentModel))
+    if (url.pathname === "/api/agent") {
+      return json({
+        location: { directory, project: { id: "proj_test", directory } },
+        data: agentsPayload(input.agentVariant, agentModel),
+      })
+    }
+    if (url.pathname === "/session") return json(sessions)
+    if (url.pathname.startsWith("/session/")) {
+      const parts = url.pathname.split("/")
+      const sessionID = parts[2]
+      const suffix = parts[3]
+      const row = sessions.find((item) => item.id === sessionID)
+      if (suffix === "message" || suffix === "todo" || suffix === "diff") return json([])
+      if (row) return json(row)
+      return json({ id: sessionID })
+    }
+    return undefined
+  }, events)
+
+  // session.update is a PATCH whose body the URL-only fetch fixture cannot
+  // see, so wrap it to capture and answer the metadata writes under test.
+  const fetch = (async (raw: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
+    const request = raw instanceof Request ? raw : new Request(raw, init)
+    const url = new URL(request.url)
+    if (request.method === "PATCH" && url.pathname.startsWith("/session/")) {
+      const sessionID = url.pathname.slice("/session/".length)
+      const body = (await request.clone().json()) as Record<string, unknown>
+      updates.push({ sessionID, body })
+      const row = sessions.find((item) => item.id === sessionID)
+      return json(row ? { ...row, metadata: body.metadata ?? row.metadata } : { id: sessionID })
+    }
+    return calls.fetch(request)
+  }) as typeof globalThis.fetch
+
+  const config = createTuiResolvedConfig({})
+  let captured: Pick<Harness, "local" | "route" | "sync"> | undefined
+  let done!: () => void
+  const ready = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
+    done = resolve
+  })
+
+  function Capture() {
+    const local = useLocal()
+    const route = useRoute()
+    const sync = useSync()
+    onMount(() => {
+      captured = { local, route, sync }
+      done()
+    })
+    return null
+  }
+
+  function Harness(props: { children: () => JSX.Element }) {
+    const renderer = useRenderer()
+    const keymap = createDefaultOpenTuiKeymap(renderer)
+    const off = registerOpencodeKeymap(keymap, renderer, config)
+    onCleanup(off)
+
+    return (
+      <ClipboardProvider>
+        <OpencodeKeymapProvider keymap={keymap}>
+          <ToastProvider>
+            <RouteProvider initialRoute={input.route}>
+              <TuiConfigProvider config={config}>
+                <PluginRuntimeProvider value={createPluginRuntime()}>
+                  <SDKProvider url="http://test" directory={directory} fetch={fetch} events={events.source}>
+                    <PermissionProvider>
+                      <ProjectProvider>
+                        <LocationProvider>
+                          <EditorContextProvider>
+                            <ExitProvider exit={() => {}}>
+                              <EpilogueProvider set={() => {}}>
+                                <SyncProvider>
+                                  <DataProvider>
+                                    <ThemeProvider mode="dark">
+                                      <LocalProvider>
+                                        <Capture />
+                                        <PromptStashProvider>
+                                          <DialogProvider>
+                                            <FrecencyProvider>
+                                              <PromptHistoryProvider>
+                                                <PromptRefProvider>{props.children()}</PromptRefProvider>
+                                              </PromptHistoryProvider>
+                                            </FrecencyProvider>
+                                          </DialogProvider>
+                                        </PromptStashProvider>
+                                      </LocalProvider>
+                                      {/* Production mounts the toast surface on
+                                          the home and session routes; the
+                                          harness renders it directly so no-op
+                                          toasts stay visible. */}
+                                      <Toast />
+                                    </ThemeProvider>
+                                  </DataProvider>
+                                </SyncProvider>
+                              </EpilogueProvider>
+                            </ExitProvider>
+                          </EditorContextProvider>
+                        </LocationProvider>
+                      </ProjectProvider>
+                    </PermissionProvider>
+                  </SDKProvider>
+                </PluginRuntimeProvider>
+              </TuiConfigProvider>
+            </RouteProvider>
+          </ToastProvider>
+        </OpencodeKeymapProvider>
+      </ClipboardProvider>
+    )
+  }
+
+  const app = await testRender(
+    () => (
+      <TestTuiContexts directory={directory} paths={{ home: "/tmp", state: tmp.path, worktree: directory }}>
+        <ArgsProvider model={input.model}>
+          <KVProvider>
+            <Harness>{input.children}</Harness>
+          </KVProvider>
+        </ArgsProvider>
+      </TestTuiContexts>
+    ),
+    { width: 120, height: 40 },
+  )
+
+  await ready
+  await wait(() => captured!.sync.status === "complete")
+
+  return {
+    app,
+    local: captured!.local,
+    route: captured!.route,
+    sync: captured!.sync,
+    updates,
+    async dispose() {
+      app.renderer.destroy()
+      await tmp[Symbol.asyncDispose]()
+    },
+  }
+}
+
+async function frameWhere(app: Setup, predicate: (frame: string) => boolean, label: string) {
+  for (let pass = 0; pass < 200; pass++) {
+    await app.renderOnce()
+    const frame = app.captureCharFrame()
+    if (predicate(frame)) return frame
+    await Bun.sleep(10)
+  }
+  throw new Error(`timed out waiting for frame: ${label}`)
+}
+
+function lineOf(frame: string, needle: string) {
+  return frame.split("\n").find((line) => line.includes(needle)) ?? ""
+}
+
+function markerLine(frame: string) {
+  return frame.split("\n").find((line) => line.includes("●")) ?? ""
+}
+
+describe("agent effort selector", () => {
+  test("renders three levels with process meanings and the session's selection", async () => {
+    const harness = await mountEffort({
+      route: { type: "session", sessionID: SESSION_THOROUGH },
+      model: "test-provider/variant-model",
+      children: () => <DialogAgentEffort />,
+    })
+    try {
+      expect(harness.local.effort.current()).toBe("thorough")
+      const frame = await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("Agent effort"), "dialog title")
+      expect(frame).toContain("Fast")
+      expect(frame).toContain("Medium")
+      expect(frame).toContain("Thorough")
+      expect(frame).toContain("no review ritual")
+      expect(frame).toContain("up to 2 review passes")
+      expect(frame).toContain("review until clean")
+      expect(frame).toContain("Stored on this session")
+      expect(markerLine(frame)).toContain("Thorough")
+    } finally {
+      await harness.dispose()
+    }
+  })
+
+  test("persists a selection on the active session and preserves unrelated metadata", async () => {
+    const harness = await mountEffort({
+      route: { type: "session", sessionID: SESSION_FAST },
+      model: "test-provider/variant-model",
+      children: () => <DialogAgentEffort />,
+    })
+    try {
+      await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("Agent effort"), "dialog title")
+      expect(harness.local.effort.current()).toBe("fast")
+      harness.app.mockInput.pressArrow("down")
+      harness.app.mockInput.pressEnter()
+      await wait(() => harness.updates.length >= 1, 3000)
+      const [update] = harness.updates
+      expect(update.sessionID).toBe(SESSION_FAST)
+      expect(update.body.metadata).toEqual({ agentEffort: "medium", task: "keep-me" })
+      // the pending write is visible immediately, before any sync event lands
+      expect(harness.local.effort.current()).toBe("medium")
+    } finally {
+      await harness.dispose()
+    }
+  })
+
+  test("keeps selections isolated across session switches and no-ops on home", async () => {
+    const harness = await mountEffort({
+      route: { type: "session", sessionID: SESSION_THOROUGH },
+      model: "test-provider/variant-model",
+      children: () => <DialogAgentEffort />,
+    })
+    try {
+      const first = await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("Agent effort"), "dialog title")
+      expect(markerLine(first)).toContain("Thorough")
+
+      harness.route.navigate({ type: "session", sessionID: SESSION_PLAIN })
+      const switched = await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => markerLine(f).includes("Fast"), "marker on plain session")
+      expect(harness.local.effort.current()).toBe("fast")
+      expect(switched).toContain("Stored on this session")
+
+      harness.route.navigate({ type: "home" })
+      await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("Config default"), "home footer")
+      expect(harness.local.effort.current()).toBe("fast")
+      harness.app.mockInput.pressEnter()
+      await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("Agent effort applies per session"), "home toast")
+      expect(harness.updates.length).toBe(0)
+    } finally {
+      await harness.dispose()
+    }
+  })
+
+  test("labels effort in the prompt for models without thinking variants", async () => {
+    const harness = await mountEffort({
+      route: { type: "home" },
+      model: "test-provider/plain-model",
+      children: () => <Prompt />,
+    })
+    try {
+      const frame = await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("PlainModel"), "prompt meta row")
+      expect(lineOf(frame, "PlainModel")).toContain("fast")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.list()).toEqual([])
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBeUndefined()
+    } finally {
+      await harness.dispose()
+    }
+  })
+
+  test("shows effort beside an explicit thinking choice and never clobbers it", async () => {
+    const harness = await mountEffort({
+      route: { type: "session", sessionID: SESSION_THOROUGH },
+      model: "test-provider/variant-model",
+      children: () => <Prompt />,
+    })
+    try {
+      await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("VariantModel"), "prompt meta row")
+      harness.local.model.variant.set("high")
+      await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => lineOf(f, "VariantModel").includes("high"), "variant label")
+
+      harness.local.effort.set("fast")
+      await wait(() => harness.updates.length >= 1, 3000)
+      expect(harness.updates[0].body.metadata).toEqual({ agentEffort: "fast", task: "keep-me" })
+      expect(harness.local.effort.current()).toBe("fast")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBe("high")
+
+      const after = await frameWhere(
+        harness.app,
+        (f) => {
+          const line = lineOf(f, "VariantModel")
+          return line.includes("fast") && line.includes("high")
+        },
+        "effort label beside thinking",
+      )
+      expect(after).toContain("· fast")
+    } finally {
+      await harness.dispose()
+    }
+  })
+
+  test("applies the coupled thinking default only when nothing chose thinking", async () => {
+    const harness = await mountEffort({
+      route: { type: "session", sessionID: SESSION_THOROUGH },
+      model: "test-provider/variant-model",
+      children: () => <DialogAgentEffort />,
+    })
+    try {
+      await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("Agent effort"), "dialog title")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBeUndefined()
+
+      harness.local.effort.set("fast")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBe("low")
+      harness.local.effort.set("thorough")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBe("high")
+
+      // an explicit default/off selection is still a selection: no clobber
+      harness.local.model.variant.set(undefined)
+      harness.local.effort.set("fast")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBeUndefined()
+
+      await wait(() => harness.updates.length >= 3, 3000)
+      expect(harness.updates.map((update) => update.body.metadata)).toEqual([
+        { agentEffort: "fast", task: "keep-me" },
+        { agentEffort: "thorough", task: "keep-me" },
+        { agentEffort: "fast", task: "keep-me" },
+      ])
+    } finally {
+      await harness.dispose()
+    }
+  })
+
+  test("keeps a real selector choice from being re-coupled by effort changes", async () => {
+    const harness = await mountEffort({
+      route: { type: "session", sessionID: SESSION_THOROUGH },
+      model: "test-provider/variant-model",
+      children: () => <DialogAgentEffort />,
+    })
+    try {
+      await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("Agent effort"), "dialog title")
+      // A direct selector write becomes explicit provenance for this model.
+      harness.local.model.variant.set("medium")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBe("medium")
+
+      harness.local.effort.set("fast")
+      // The dial must not re-couple `low` over the user's explicit choice.
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBe("medium")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.selected()).toBe("medium")
+
+      harness.local.effort.set("thorough")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBe("medium")
+
+      await wait(() => harness.updates.length >= 2, 3000)
+      expect(harness.updates.map((update) => update.body.metadata)).toEqual([
+        { agentEffort: "fast", task: "keep-me" },
+        { agentEffort: "thorough", task: "keep-me" },
+      ])
+    } finally {
+      await harness.dispose()
+    }
+  })
+
+  test("keeps a configured thinking variant when effort changes", async () => {
+    const harness = await mountEffort({
+      route: { type: "session", sessionID: SESSION_THOROUGH },
+      model: "test-provider/variant-model",
+      agentVariant: "high",
+      children: () => <DialogAgentEffort />,
+    })
+    try {
+      await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("Agent effort"), "dialog title")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBe("high")
+      harness.local.effort.set("fast")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBe("high")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.selected()).toBeUndefined()
+      await wait(() => harness.updates.length >= 1, 3000)
+      expect(harness.local.effort.current()).toBe("fast")
+    } finally {
+      await harness.dispose()
+    }
+  })
+
+  test("keeps behavior unchanged for models without thinking variants", async () => {
+    const harness = await mountEffort({
+      route: { type: "session", sessionID: SESSION_THOROUGH },
+      model: "test-provider/plain-model",
+      children: () => <DialogAgentEffort />,
+    })
+    try {
+      await frameWhere(harness.app, (f) => f.includes("Agent effort"), "dialog title")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.list()).toEqual([])
+      harness.local.effort.set("fast")
+      expect(harness.local.model.variant.current()).toBeUndefined()
+      await wait(() => harness.updates.length >= 1, 3000)
+      expect(harness.updates[0].body.metadata).toEqual({ agentEffort: "fast", task: "keep-me" })
+      expect(harness.local.effort.current()).toBe("fast")
+    } finally {
+      await harness.dispose()
+    }
+  })
+})

+test("effort selection prefers the pending write, then session metadata, then config", () => {
+  const config = { agent: { effort: "thorough" } }
+  expect(effortSelection({ override: { agentEffort: "fast" }, metadata: { agentEffort: "thorough" }, config })).toBe(
+    "fast",
+  )
+  expect(effortSelection({ metadata: { agentEffort: "thorough" }, config })).toBe("thorough")
+  // Untrusted session metadata falls through to the configured default
+  // instead of masking it.
+  expect(effortSelection({ metadata: { agentEffort: "turbo" }, config })).toBe("thorough")
+  expect(effortSelection({ config: { agent: { effort: "fast" } } })).toBe("fast")
+  expect(effortSelection({})).toBe("medium")
+})
+
+test("a session without a persisted selection starts from config, not a leaked value", () => {
+  // Switching sessions only passes that session's own metadata and pending
+  // overlay: the previous session's selection is looked up by its session ID
+  // and can never bleed into this lookup.
+  expect(effortSelection({ metadata: {}, config: { agent: { effort: "fast" } } })).toBe("fast")
+  expect(effortSelection({ metadata: {} })).toBe("medium")
+  expect(effortSelection({ override: {}, metadata: { agentEffort: "thorough" } })).toBe("thorough")
+})
+
+test("effort updates merge over pending and synced metadata for one session", () => {
+  const merged = effortUpdateFor({
+    sessionID: "ses_a",
+    metadata: { agentEffort: "medium", task: "keep-me" },
+    level: "fast",
+  })
+  expect(merged).toEqual({
+    sessionID: "ses_a",
+    metadata: { agentEffort: "fast", task: "keep-me" },
+  })
+
+  // A second rapid selection unions the pending record over the still-stale
+  // row, so the first write's keys and any newly synced keys both survive.
+  expect(
+    effortUpdateFor({
+      sessionID: "ses_a",
+      override: { agentEffort: "fast", task: "keep-me" },
+      metadata: { agentEffort: "medium", task: "keep-me", synced: "new" },
+      level: "thorough",
+    }),
+  ).toEqual({
+    sessionID: "ses_a",
+    metadata: { agentEffort: "thorough", task: "keep-me", synced: "new" },
+  })
+})
+
+test("repeating the current effort is idempotent and targets only its session", () => {
+  expect(
+    effortUpdateFor({ sessionID: "ses_a", metadata: { agentEffort: "fast", other: 1 }, level: "fast" }),
+  ).toBeUndefined()
+  expect(
+    effortUpdateFor({
+      sessionID: "ses_a",
+      override: { agentEffort: "fast" },
+      metadata: { agentEffort: "medium" },
+      level: "fast",
+    }),
+  ).toBeUndefined()
+  expect(effortUpdateFor({ sessionID: "ses_b", metadata: { agentEffort: "fast" }, level: "thorough" })).toEqual({
+    sessionID: "ses_b",
+    metadata: { agentEffort: "thorough" },
+  })
+})

+import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test"
+import {
+  configLevel,
+  coupledThinking,
+  finishStatus,
+  finishStatusLines,
+  mergeEffortMetadata,
+  metadataLevel,
+  nextLevel,
+  resolveEffort,
+} from "../../src/util/agent-effort"
+
+describe("agent effort resolution", () => {
+  test("reads only a closed literal from session metadata", () => {
+    expect(metadataLevel({ agentEffort: "fast" })).toBe("fast")
+    expect(metadataLevel({ agentEffort: "medium" })).toBe("medium")
+    expect(metadataLevel({ agentEffort: "thorough" })).toBe("thorough")
+    expect(metadataLevel({ agentEffort: "turbo" })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(metadataLevel({ agentEffort: 5 })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(metadataLevel({})).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(metadataLevel(undefined)).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(metadataLevel("fast")).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(metadataLevel(["fast"])).toBeUndefined()
+    // A legacy named agent whose `effort` entry is an object never parses
+    // as the scalar policy setting.
+    expect(metadataLevel({ agentEffort: { model: "provider/model" } })).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  test("reads the reserved scalar config setting without trusting named agents", () => {
+    expect(configLevel({ agent: { effort: "thorough" } })).toBe("thorough")
+    expect(configLevel({ agent: { effort: "fast", work: { model: "a/b" } } })).toBe("fast")
+    expect(configLevel({ agent: { effort: "medium" } })).toBe("medium")
+    expect(configLevel({ agent: { effort: "turbo" } })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(configLevel({ agent: { effort: { model: "a/b" } } })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(configLevel({ agent: { work: { model: "a/b" } } })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(configLevel({ model: "a/b" })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(configLevel(undefined)).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  test("applies session, config, then medium precedence for untrusted input", () => {
+    const config = { agent: { effort: "thorough" } }
+    expect(resolveEffort({ metadata: { agentEffort: "fast" }, config })).toBe("fast")
+    expect(resolveEffort({ metadata: { agentEffort: "bogus" }, config })).toBe("thorough")
+    expect(resolveEffort({ metadata: { agentEffort: "bogus" }, config: { agent: { effort: "nope" } } })).toBe("medium")
+    expect(resolveEffort({ config })).toBe("thorough")
+    expect(resolveEffort({})).toBe("medium")
+    expect(resolveEffort({ fallback: "fast" })).toBe("fast")
+    expect(resolveEffort({ metadata: { agentEffort: "thorough" }, fallback: "fast" })).toBe("thorough")
+  })
+
+  test("merges metadata so unrelated keys survive every effort write", () => {
+    expect(mergeEffortMetadata({ agentEffort: "medium", task: "abc", nested: { a: 1 } }, "fast")).toEqual({
+      agentEffort: "fast",
+      task: "abc",
+      nested: { a: 1 },
+    })
+    expect(mergeEffortMetadata({ other: true }, "thorough")).toEqual({ agentEffort: "thorough", other: true })
+    expect(mergeEffortMetadata(undefined, "fast")).toEqual({ agentEffort: "fast" })
+    expect(mergeEffortMetadata(["not", "a", "record"], "fast")).toEqual({ agentEffort: "fast" })
+  })
+
+  test("cycles the dial fast → medium → thorough → fast", () => {
+    expect(nextLevel("fast")).toBe("medium")
+    expect(nextLevel("medium")).toBe("thorough")
+    expect(nextLevel("thorough")).toBe("fast")
+  })
+})
+
+describe("coupled thinking defaults", () => {
+  test("prefers low/medium/high only when the model offers the variant", () => {
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "fast", variants: ["low", "medium", "high"] })).toBe("low")
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "medium", variants: ["low", "medium", "high"] })).toBe("medium")
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "thorough", variants: ["low", "medium", "high"] })).toBe("high")
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "fast", variants: ["high"] })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "fast" })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "fast", variants: [] })).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  test("never applies over an explicit choice, including explicit default/off", () => {
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "fast", variants: ["low"], chosen: "default" })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "thorough", variants: ["high"], chosen: "high" })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "fast", variants: ["low"], chosen: "medium" })).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  test("never applies over a configured agent or model variant", () => {
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "fast", variants: ["low"], configured: "high" })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "fast", variants: ["low"], configured: "" })).toBe("low")
+    expect(coupledThinking({ effort: "fast", variants: ["low"], chosen: undefined })).toBe("low")
+  })
+})
+
+describe("honest finish status", () => {
+  test("keeps legacy transcript labels readable", () => {
+    const approved = finishStatus({
+      review: { verdict: "approved", reviews: 1, maxIterations: 5, termination: "approved" },
+    })
+    expect(approved?.review).toEqual({ label: "approved", detail: "1/5 passes", tone: "success" })
+
+    expect(finishStatus({ review: { termination: "skipped", reviews: 0, maxIterations: 5 } })?.review?.label).toBe(
+      "skipped",
+    )
+    expect(finishStatus({ review: { termination: "review-cap", reviews: 5, maxIterations: 5 } })?.review?.label).toBe(
+      "cap",
+    )
+    expect(finishStatus({ verdict: "approved" })).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(finishStatus(undefined)).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(finishStatus({})).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(finishStatus("review")).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  test("shows fast delivery as unreviewed, never approved", () => {
+    const status = finishStatus({
+      review: {
+        effort: "fast",
+        disposition: "unreviewed",
+        reviews: 0,
+        termination: "unreviewed",
+        openFindings: 0,
+        blockingFindings: 0,
+        workSinceReview: false,
+      },
+    })
+    expect(status?.review?.label).toBe("unreviewed")
+    expect(status?.review?.tone).toBe("warning")
+    expect(status?.review?.detail).toBe("fast · 0 passes")
+    expect(JSON.stringify(status)).not.toContain("approved")
+  })
+
+  test("reports exhausted budgets with open and stale findings intact", () => {
+    const status = finishStatus({
+      review: {
+        effort: "medium",
+        disposition: "reviewed",
+        reviews: 2,
+        maxIterations: 2,
+        termination: "budget-exhausted",
+        openFindings: 3,
+        blockingFindings: 1,
+        workSinceReview: true,
+      },
+    })
+    expect(status?.review?.label).toBe("budget exhausted")
+    expect(status?.review?.detail).toBe("medium · 2/2 passes · 3 open, 1 blocking · stale")
+    expect(status?.review?.tone).toBe("warning")
+  })
+
+  test("shows findings-open and stale-after-review without upgrading to approved", () => {
+    const status = finishStatus({
+      review: {
+        disposition: "reviewed",
+        termination: "findings-open",
+        reviews: 1,
+        openFindings: 2,
+        workSinceReview: 1,
+      },
+    })
+    expect(status?.review?.label).toBe("findings open")
+    expect(status?.review?.detail).toContain("2 open")
+    expect(status?.review?.detail).toContain("stale")
+
+    const staleOnly = finishStatus({
+      review: { disposition: "reviewed", termination: "approved", workSinceReview: true },
+    })
+    expect(staleOnly?.review?.detail).toContain("stale")
+  })
+
+  test("reports reviewer unavailability with its visible reason", () => {
+    const status = finishStatus({
+      review: {
+        effort: "thorough",
+        disposition: "unreviewed",
+        termination: "review-unavailable",
+        unavailableReason: "no reviewer agent permitted at depth 3",
+      },
+    })
+    expect(status?.review?.label).toBe("review unavailable")
+    expect(status?.review?.detail).toContain("no reviewer agent permitted at depth 3")
+    expect(status?.review?.tone).toBe("warning")
+  })
+
+  test("distinguishes exemption from approval for read-only work", () => {
+    const status = finishStatus({ review: { disposition: "unreviewed", termination: "not-required", reviews: 0 } })
+    expect(status?.review?.label).toBe("not required")
+    expect(status?.review?.tone).toBe("text")
+
+    expect(finishStatus({ review: { termination: "waiting" } })?.review?.label).toBe("waiting")
+    expect(finishStatus({ review: { disposition: "reviewed", reviews: 1 } })?.review?.label).toBe("reviewed")
+  })
+
+  test("never serializes an infinite thorough budget", () => {
+    const status = finishStatus({
+      review: { effort: "thorough", disposition: "reviewed", reviews: 4, maxIterations: Infinity },
+    })
+    expect(status?.review?.detail).toBe("thorough · 4 passes")
+    expect(JSON.stringify(status)).not.toContain("Infinity")
+  })
+
+  test("surfaces failed, missing, and not-run validation evidence", () => {
+    const passed = finishStatus({
+      validation: {
+        gate: "standard",
+        status: "passed",
+        checks: [{ category: "tests", status: "passed" }],
+        source: "agent-reported",
+      },
+    })
+    expect(passed?.validation?.label).toBe("validation passed")
+    expect(passed?.validation?.tone).toBe("success")
+    expect(passed?.validation?.detail).toBe("standard")
+
+    const failed = finishStatus({
+      validation: {
+        gate: "full",
+        status: "failed",
+        checks: [
+          { category: "tests", status: "failed" },
+          { category: "typecheck", status: "not-run" },
+          { category: "parity", status: "not-applicable" },
+        ],
+      },
+    })
+    expect(failed?.validation?.label).toBe("validation failed")
+    expect(failed?.validation?.tone).toBe("warning")
+    expect(failed?.validation?.detail).toBe("full · tests: failed · typecheck: not-run · parity: not-applicable")
+
+    const incomplete = finishStatus({ validation: { gate: "minimal", status: "incomplete", checks: [] } })
+    expect(incomplete?.validation?.label).toBe("validation incomplete")
+    expect(incomplete?.validation?.tone).toBe("text")
+    expect(JSON.stringify(incomplete)).not.toContain("passed")
+
+    const unknown = finishStatus({ validation: { checks: [{ category: "smoke", status: "not-run" }] } })
+    expect(unknown?.validation?.label).toBe("validation")
+    expect(unknown?.validation?.detail).toContain("smoke: not-run")
+  })
+
+  test("renders review and validation lines together for the transcript", () => {
+    const lines = finishStatusLines({
+      review: { label: "budget exhausted", detail: "medium · 2/2 passes", tone: "warning" },
+      validation: { label: "validation incomplete", detail: "standard · tests: not-run", tone: "text" },
+    })
+    expect(lines).toEqual([
+      "review: budget exhausted · medium · 2/2 passes",
+      "validation incomplete · standard · tests: not-run",
+    ])
+    expect(
+      finishStatusLines({
+        review: { label: "unreviewed", tone: "warning" },
+      }),
+    ).toEqual(["review: unreviewed"])
+  })
+})

+# Agent effort
+
+The agent effort dial controls how much process a task gets before its result is
+delivered. There are exactly three levels and two switches — no other knobs.
+
+## Levels
+
+| Level              | Review passes                | Validation gate |
+| ------------------ | ---------------------------- | --------------- |
+| `fast`             | none required                | minimal         |
+| `medium` (default) | at least one; bounded by two | standard        |
+| `thorough`         | until-clean, no finite cap   | full            |
+
+- **`fast`** delivers as soon as the work is done. No independent review is
+  required; the delivery is honestly labelled `unreviewed` unless a review
+  actually happened.
+- **`medium`** requires at least one clean synchronous review of the current
+  tree before delivery. Only blocking findings (Critical/Important, or a
+  Needs-fixes report with no findings) or work landed after the last review
+  force another pass; after two passes the result is delivered with an honest
+  exhausted/open-findings status instead of looping forever.
+- **`thorough`** keeps requiring a clean, current independent review until one
+  exists. When the reviewer genuinely cannot run (permission, missing agent, or
+  the subagent depth limit), delivery happens as `review-unavailable` — never
+  upgraded to approval.
+
+## Configuration
+
+The canonical setting is the nested `agent.effort` scalar in `opencode.json`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "agent": {
+    "effort": "fast"
+  }
+}
+```
+
+- Omitted, the level is `medium`. Invalid values are rejected at load time.
+- The setting is a policy, not an agent: it is never enumerated as a named
+  agent, and named agent definitions live separately under `agents` (or the
+  legacy `agent` map). Both survive together in mixed documents; when a legacy
+  document and a native v2 document define the same agent or provider, the
+  native definition wins.
+- A legacy named agent literally called `effort` (object-valued entry) keeps
+  migrating as a named agent, not as the policy.
+
+## Effective level precedence
+
+For any given task the effective level is resolved in this order:
+
+1. an explicit `task()` override;
+2. the child's persisted selection when resuming an owned child;
+3. the parent's persisted selection for a new child;
+4. the root session's persisted selection;
+5. the `agent.effort` configuration;
+6. `medium`.
+
+The selection persists on the session (including forks, which copy the
+selection) and siblings stay independent: one child's level never leaks into
+another. A task dispatched by a parent that does not own the child (for
+example, a `task_id` from another parent) neither reads nor writes that child's
+selection, and no effort is published for it in the task metadata.
+
+## Where enforcement lives
+
+`finish` is the only enforcement checkpoint. It evaluates the persisted
+history of the current user turn and, when the effective level requires an
+independent review that has not happened, declines the call with recoverable
+feedback. Repeating `finish` never waives a required review: the decision
+depends only on the persisted review state. The reviewer must run
+synchronously (`subagent_type: "review"`, `background: false`); a background
+review, a failed review, a malformed report, or a review of a different turn
+does not count. `failure` and `subagent_wait` endings and read-only turns
+deliver without the review ritual, with statuses (`unreviewed`, `waiting`,
+`not-required`) that are distinct from approval.
+
+A background child's delegated writes are accounted when its completion
+notification lands; a `finish` issued before that lands sees the turn as
+write-free and is exempt, and the next turn is gated on the recorded writes.
+
+## Validation evidence
+
+The `finish` tool accepts an optional agent-reported validation declaration:
+
+```json
+{
+  "checks": [{ "category": "syntax", "status": "passed", "detail": "biome check" }]
+}
+```
+
+- Categories: `syntax`, `smoke`, `tests`, `typecheck`, `parity`. Statuses:
+  `passed`, `failed`, `not-run`, `not-applicable`.
+- The minimal gate is satisfied by either applicable check (syntax **or**
+  smoke) passing, or by both being explicitly not-applicable. The standard
+  gate requires `tests`; the full gate requires `tests`, `typecheck`, and
+  `parity` (an explicit not-applicable satisfies a category).
+- A `failed` check fails the report regardless of everything else. Empty,
+  all-not-run, or missing evidence stays `incomplete`, and incomplete or
+  failed evidence stays visible in the result even when review is clean.
+- Nothing here is executed or verified: these checks are reported evidence
+  only, recorded as `metadata.validation` with `source: "agent-reported"`.
+
+## Delivery status
+
+`metadata.review` on a finished task carries the honest delivery labels:
+`effort`, `disposition` (`reviewed` or `unreviewed`), `reviews`, an optional
+finite `maxIterations`, `termination`, `openFindings`, `blockingFindings`,
+`workSinceReview`, and an optional `unavailableReason`. `termination` is one
+of `approved`, `unreviewed`, `findings-open`, `budget-exhausted`,
+`review-unavailable`, `not-required`, or `waiting`. `reviewed` means a valid
+independent review was performed — not that the current tree is clean; the
+termination and stale/open fields carry that distinction.
+
+## Legacy compatibility
+
+The older `review_loop.max_iterations` configuration remains readable by older
+tooling but does not override the effort policy: the pass budget belongs to
+the level (`medium` is two, `thorough` is until-clean). Legacy transcripts
+with the old nudge/cap metadata remain readable, but the old
+skip-on-repeat-finish behavior is gone.
